definition_en: to mix into a liquid until the solid disappears, or to end a group or marriage officially
core_image: 一块方糖落进热水，棱角一圈圈化掉，最后连影子都不剩
scene: 杯底的糖已经看不见了，只剩一圈浅浅的漩涡。Stir the tea until the sugar dissolves.
sceneCN: 这里 dissolve 指「溶解」（第 1 个义项：固体化进液体里）；句意是搅动茶水，直到糖化开。

senses.title: To melt into a liquid
senses.definition: to mix with a liquid until the solid can no longer be seen
senses.definitionCN: 与液体混合，直到看不见固体
senses.example: Salt dissolves faster in warm water.
senses.exampleCN: 盐在温水里化得更快。
senses.why: The solid does not vanish; it simply stops having an edge.
senses.whyCN: 固体没有消失，只是失去了棱角。

senses.title: To bring a body to an end
senses.definition: to officially end a group, a parliament, or a marriage
senses.definitionCN: 正式结束一个团体、议会或婚姻
senses.example: The king dissolved parliament that winter.
senses.exampleCN: 国王在那年冬天解散了议会。
senses.why: An assembly is held together by rules, and rules can be withdrawn.
senses.whyCN: 议会靠规则聚在一起，规则一撤，人也就散了。

senses.title: To fade away
senses.definition: to disappear gradually, as if melted into the surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 像化进周围一样渐渐消失
senses.example: The crowd dissolved into the night.
senses.exampleCN: 人群散进夜色里。
senses.why: What melts leaves no pieces to count.
senses.whyCN: 化掉的东西，连碎片都数不出来。

intro.en: Dissolve comes from Latin dis-, apart, plus solvere, to loosen: a knot undone until nothing holds.
intro.cn: dissolve 来自拉丁语 dis-（分开）加 solvere（松开），画面是一个结被彻底解开。

items.en: Solvere meant to loosen, untie or set free.
items.cn: solvere 指松开、解开或释放。

items.en: Dis- added the sense of apart, so the loosening went all the way through.
items.cn: 前缀 dis- 加上分开之意，松开就变得彻底。

items.en: Dissolvere described a solid losing its shape in liquid.
items.cn: dissolvere 描绘固体在液体里失去形状。

items.en: English borrowed it for melting and for ending an assembly.
items.cn: 英语借入后既指化开，也指解散集会。

items.en: Writers stretched it to crowds and feelings fading away.
items.cn: 文人把它扩展到人群与情绪渐渐消散。

items.en: Today a tablet, a parliament and a marriage can all dissolve.
items.cn: 今天药片、议会与婚姻都可以用这个词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the solve stem, while the meaning group gathers other ways of coming apart.
note.cn: 形近组共享 solve 这段词干，近义组则是几个表示化开或散去的词。

entries.definition: to find an answer to a problem
an answer, or a liquid with something mixed in
entries.definitionCN: 答案，或溶有他物的液体

entries.definition: a liquid that can dissolve other things
to turn from solid to liquid through heat
to break up a group or band
to grow faint and slowly disappear

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep one picture in view: a lump that loses its edges until nothing is left to hold.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守住一幅画面：一块东西失去棱角，最后什么也抓不住。

normal.en: Dis- plus solve: the knot is fully loosened.
normal.cn: dis 加 solve，就是把这个结彻底松开。

normal.en: Sugar in hot tea shows the whole process in a minute.
normal.cn: 热茶里的糖一分钟就演完全过程。

normal.en: A tablet dissolves and the water stays clear.
normal.cn: 药片化开，水还是清的。

normal.en: Parliament dissolves, and the benches empty by evening.
normal.cn: 议会一解散，傍晚椅子就空了。

normal.en: The crowd dissolved, and the square went quiet.
normal.cn: 人群散去，广场安静下来。

abstract.en: Picture a cube of ice losing its corners.
abstract.cn: 想象一块冰先失去四个角。

abstract.en: Picture a knot pulled until the rope is straight.
abstract.cn: 想象一个结被拉到绳子笔直。

abstract.en: Picture chalk marks washed off a blackboard.
abstract.cn: 想象黑板上的粉笔字被水冲掉。

examples.en: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water.
examples.cn: 糖在热水里化得很快。

examples.en: The new law dissolved the old committee.
examples.cn: 新法律解散了旧委员会。

examples.en: The crowd dissolved into the dark streets.
examples.cn: 人群散进黑暗的街道。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dissolve 记成「松开就化」：dis 表示分开，solve 表示松开，一松开，固体就化进水里，团体也就散了。

root: 源自拉丁语 dissolvere，由表示分开的 dis- 与表示松开的 solvere 组成，本义是把结解开、把整体拆散。英语先用来指固体化进液体，也指正式解散机构或婚姻，后来引申为渐渐消散。

sensesIntro.en: From a solid losing its edges in water to a group losing its rules and drifting apart.
sensesIntro.cn: 从固体在水里失去棱角，到一个团体失去规则、各自走散。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sugar cube sinking in hot tea, its edges softening until nothing is left.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块方糖沉进热茶，棱角慢慢软掉，最后什么都不剩。

branches.en: The first sense is the solid vanishing into the liquid.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是固体化进液体里不见了。

branches.en: The second sense ends an official body by removing its rules.
branches.cn: 第二个义项靠撤掉规则来结束一个正式机构。

branches.en: The third sense lets a crowd thin out until the place is empty.
branches.cn: 第三个义项让人群渐渐稀疏，直到场地空了。

branches.en: Both senses undo something that was held together.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在拆开原本聚在一起的东西。

branches.en: Only the second sense needs a formal decision by an authority.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项需要权威方面作出正式决定。

intro.en: Dissolve belongs to the solve family, where Latin solvere, to loosen, meets several prefixes.
intro.cn: dissolve 属于 solve 一族，中心是拉丁语 solvere（松开），前后接上不同前缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin solvere, to loosen, gives solve, solution and solvent; dis- pulls the loosening apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 solvere（松开）给出 solve、solution 与 solvent，前缀 dis- 把松开推向彻底分开。

items.meaning: to loosen apart until the solid is gone
to loosen a problem and find the answer
the answer, or a liquid mixture
a liquid that loosens other substances
the act of dissolving or ending
items.example: The dissolution of the firm took a year.
Undissolved salt lay at the bottom.

definition_en: the amount of space between two places or things, or a cool gap between people
core_image: 两盏路灯之间那段走不到头的黑
scene: 街这头看得见那头的灯，中间隔着一大段黑。She walked the whole distance without looking back.
sceneCN: 这里 distance 指「距离」（第 1 个义项：两点之间的远近）；句意是她走完全程都没有回头。

collocations.phrase: at a distance of ten metres

senses.title: The space between two points
senses.definition: the amount of space between two places or things
senses.definitionCN: 两个地点或物体之间的空间大小
senses.example: Measure the distance between the two posts.
senses.exampleCN: 量一量两根柱子之间的距离。
senses.why: Space becomes something you can count in steps.
senses.whyCN: 空间变成了可以用脚步去数的东西。

senses.title: The far part of a view
senses.definition: the place far away that you can see but not reach easily
senses.definitionCN: 看得见却不容易走到的那片远处
senses.example: A light shone in the distance.
senses.exampleCN: 远处亮着一盏灯。
senses.why: The eye stops at the horizon and calls it a place.
senses.whyCN: 目光停在地平线上，就把它叫作一个地方。

senses.title: A cool gap between people
senses.definition: a lack of closeness between people, or the act of keeping apart
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间缺少亲近，或主动保持间隔
senses.example: A quiet distance grew between the brothers.
senses.exampleCN: 兄弟之间渐渐生出一种沉默的疏远。
senses.why: Two people in one room can still be miles apart.
senses.whyCN: 同在一间屋里，两个人也可能隔着好几里。

intro.en: Distance comes from Latin distantia, a standing apart, built on dis-, apart, and stare, to stand.
intro.cn: distance 来自拉丁语 distantia（相隔而立），由 dis-（分开）与 stare（站立）构成。

items.en: Stare meant to stand still and hold a position.
items.cn: stare 指站定不动、守住位置。

items.en: Dis- pushed the two standing points apart.
items.cn: dis- 把两个站立点推开。

items.en: Distantia measured how far apart they stood.
items.cn: distantia 量的是它们相隔多远。

items.en: Old French destance carried the measure of space.
items.cn: 古法语 destance 承接了空间尺度的意思。

items.en: English used it for space, then for time and feeling.
items.cn: 英语先用它量空间，再用来量时间与感情。

items.en: Today it covers miles, years and a cool silence.
items.cn: 今天它可以指数英里、数年，也指一段冷淡的沉默。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the stant stem, while the meaning group names other kinds of gap.
note.cn: 形近组共享 stant 这一段词干，近义组则是几个表示间隔的词。

entries.definition: far away in space or time
equally far from two points
to leave others far behind
an empty space between two things
the full length from one end to the other
entries.definitionCN: 从一端到另一端的全长

entries.definition: the state of being far away

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two points standing apart and end with two people who no longer speak.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从两个站开的点开始，落到两个不再说话的人。

normal.en: Dis- plus stance: two standing points held apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 stance，就是两个站立的点被分开。

normal.en: The bridge is two kilometres away, a short distance by car.
normal.cn: 那座桥在两公里外，开车是很短的距离。

normal.en: A figure appeared in the distance and came closer.
normal.cn: 远处出现一个人影，慢慢走近。

normal.en: He distanced himself from the quarrel.
normal.cn: 他与这场争吵保持了距离。

normal.en: Old friends can drift into a polite distance.
normal.cn: 老朋友也会慢慢疏成客气的距离。

abstract.en: Picture two lamps with a long stretch of dark between them.
abstract.cn: 想象两盏灯之间拉着一段长长的黑。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid on a map, end on end.
abstract.cn: 想象一把尺子在地图上一段段量过去。

abstract.en: Picture two chairs pushed slowly towards opposite walls.
abstract.cn: 想象两把椅子慢慢被推向相对的墙。

examples.en: The distance between the two towns is forty miles.
examples.cn: 两座城镇之间相距四十英里。

examples.en: He distanced himself from the decision.
examples.cn: 他与那个决定保持了距离。

examples.en: A dog barked in the distance.
examples.cn: 远处有只狗在叫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distance 记成「站开一段」：dis 表示分开，st 与 stand 同源表示站，两个点站开，中间就留出了距离。

root: 源自拉丁语 distantia，由表示分开的 dis- 与表示站立的 stare 构成，本义是两个点相隔而立。英语先用它量空间，后来也量时间，再引申为人与人之间的冷淡与疏远。

sensesIntro.en: From a measured space on a road to the quiet widening of a gap between two people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从路上量出的一段空间，到两个人之间悄悄拉大的空档。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two lamps standing far apart with a long stretch of dark between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两盏灯远远分开，中间拉着一大段黑。

branches.en: The first sense is plain measurable space.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是可以直接量出来的空间。

branches.en: The second sense puts that space in the far background of a view.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这段空间放到视野的最远处。

branches.en: The third sense turns space into coldness between people.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把空间变成人与人之间的冷淡。

branches.en: Both senses describe a measurable gap, one in metres and one in feeling.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在说可量的间隔，一个用米，一个用感受。

branches.en: Both senses depend on a viewpoint that feels the gap.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一个能感到这段间隔的视角。

intro.en: Distance sits in the stance family, where Latin stare, to stand, holds the whole group together.
intro.cn: distance 属于 stance 一族，中心是拉丁语 stare（站立），把整组词撑在一起。

latinIntro.en: Latin stare, to stand, gives stance and distance; dis- makes the standing points separate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stare（站立）给出 stance 与 distance，前缀 dis- 让两个站立点分开。

items.meaning: the space held between two points
items.example: The distance between the towns is forty miles.
items.exampleCN: 两镇之间相距四十英里。

items.example: His stance was firm and wide.

items.meaning: to stay upright on the feet
items.example: They stood by the gate for an hour.
items.exampleCN: 他们在门口站了一个小时。

items.meaning: in a far or cool way
items.example: She smiled distantly and said nothing.
items.exampleCN: 她淡淡一笑，什么也没说。

items.example: The village is equidistant from both cities.
items.exampleCN: 这个村子到两座城市等距。

items.meaning: to get far ahead of others
items.exampleCN: 她把全场选手远远甩开。

items.meaning: the conditions standing around an event
items.exampleCN: 在这种情况下我们等了等。

definition_en: far away in space or time, or not friendly and not paying attention
core_image: 山顶的信号塔在雾里只剩一个模糊的小点
scene: 车开出很久，那座塔缩成雾里的一个小点。He grew distant after the argument.
sceneCN: 这里 distant 指「疏远的」（第 3 个义项：不再亲近）；句意是争吵之后他变得疏远起来。

senses.title: Far away in space
senses.definition: a long way from the place where you are
senses.definitionCN: 离你所在之处有很长一段路
senses.example: A distant hill turned blue in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 雨里远处的山变成了蓝色。
senses.why: The further a thing is, the fewer details it keeps.
senses.whyCN: 东西越远，留下的细节越少。

senses.title: Far back in time
senses.definition: happening a long time ago or a long time from now
senses.definitionCN: 发生在很久以前或很久以后
senses.example: Those are stories from the distant past.
senses.exampleCN: 那些是很久以前的故事。
senses.why: Memory thins the years the way fog thins a hill.
senses.whyCN: 记忆把年月磨淡，就像雾把山磨淡。

senses.title: Cool and not quite present
senses.definition: not friendly, or not paying attention to what is here
senses.definitionCN: 不亲近，或没有把心思放在眼前
senses.example: She gave a distant nod and left.
senses.exampleCN: 她冷淡地点了下头就走了。
senses.why: A mind can move far away while the body stays in the chair.
senses.whyCN: 人还坐在椅子上，心思却能走得很远。

intro.en: Distant is the Latin present participle distans, from distare, to stand apart, built on dis- and stare.
intro.cn: distant 是拉丁语现在分词 distans，来自 distare（相隔而立），由 dis- 与 stare 组成。

items.en: Stare meant to stand and keep a place.
items.cn: stare 指站着并守住一个位置。

items.en: Dis- marked the space between the two places.
items.cn: dis- 标出两处之间的间隔。

items.en: Distans described things that stood far from each other.
items.cn: distans 描述彼此站得很远的东西。

items.en: English used it first for places on a map.
items.cn: 英语先用它说地图上的地点。

items.en: It spread to years, relatives and cool manners.
items.cn: 后来扩展到年月、亲戚与冷淡的举止。

items.en: A distant look now means a mind somewhere else.
items.cn: 今天 a distant look 指心思飘在别处。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the same standing stem, while the meaning group gathers words for far and unfriendly.
note.cn: 形近组共享「站立」这段词干，近义组则是几个表示远与冷淡的词。

entries.definition: the space between two points
in a far or cool manner
equally far from two points
a long way away
far from towns and hard to reach
friendly in no obvious way

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a small point on the horizon and end with a mind that has left the room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从地平线上的一个小点开始，落到一颗已经离屋的心思。

normal.en: Dis- plus stant: the two standing points are far apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 stant，两个站立的点隔得很开。

normal.en: A distant light on the coast means the harbour is still far.
normal.cn: 海岸上远远一盏灯，说明港口还远。

normal.en: Letters from a distant cousin arrived once a year.
normal.cn: 远房表亲的信一年来一封。

normal.en: His voice went distant when the subject came up.
normal.cn: 话题一提起，他的声音就远了。

normal.en: She seemed distant, as if listening to another room.
normal.cn: 她显得心不在焉，像在听另一个房间。

abstract.en: Picture a tower shrinking to a dot in fog.
abstract.cn: 想象一座塔在雾里缩成一个小点。

abstract.en: Picture an old photograph with faces too small to name.
abstract.cn: 想象一张老照片，脸小得认不出。

abstract.en: Picture a person answering a question a second late.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人回答问题时慢了一拍。

examples.en: The distant mountains were lost in cloud.
examples.cn: 远处的山隐进云里。

examples.en: A distant train sounded across the valley.
examples.cn: 一列火车的声音从山谷那头传来。

examples.en: He was polite but distant with strangers.
examples.cn: 他对陌生人客气而疏远。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distant 记成「站得远」：dis 表示分开，stant 与 stand 同源表示站着，站得开，就是远的，也可以指心思离得远。

root: 源自拉丁语 distare（相隔而立），由 dis-（分开）与 stare（站立）构成，现在分词为 distans。本义是位置离得远，后来用于时间上的久远，再引申为人情上的冷淡与心思上的不专注。

sensesIntro.en: From a hill far beyond the river to a face that answers you from a great distance.
sensesIntro.cn: 从河那边很远的山，到一张仿佛从很远处回答你的脸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tower on a hill shrinking into a dot in the fog.
core.cn: 核心意象：山上的塔在雾里缩成一个小点。

branches.en: The first sense is simple physical separation.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是单纯的空间相隔。

branches.en: The second sense measures separation in years.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用年月来量这段相隔。

branches.en: The third sense measures it in warmth between people.
branches.cn: 第三个义项用人与人之间的温度来量。

branches.en: Both senses keep one thing out of easy reach.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让某样东西不容易够到。

branches.en: Both senses grow stronger the longer nothing is said.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是越久不开口，就越显得明显。

intro.en: Distant gathers the stance family, where Latin stare, to stand, holds the stem steady.
intro.cn: distant 聚起 stance 一族，中心是拉丁语 stare（站立），把词干稳稳撑住。

latinIntro.en: Latin stare, to stand, gives stance and distant; dis- turns standing together into standing apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stare（站立）给出 stance 与 distant，前缀 dis- 把站在一起变成站得很开。

items.meaning: in a far or cool way

items.example: The town is equidistant from both ports.
items.exampleCN: 这座镇到两个港口等距。
她把所有对手都甩开了。

items.meaning: the conditions standing around an event

definition_en: easy to see, hear or notice, or clearly different from something else
core_image: 两条并排的白线，中间留着一道谁也不碰谁的缝
scene: 白线画得很实，边缘一点也不含糊。The two plans are distinct in almost every detail.
sceneCN: 这里 distinct 指「截然不同的」（第 2 个义项：彼此界限分明）；句意是这两个方案几乎每个细节都不同。

senses.title: Clear to the senses
senses.definition: easy to see, hear or notice, leaving no doubt
senses.definitionCN: 容易看见、听见或察觉，没有含糊
senses.example: There was a distinct smell of smoke.
senses.exampleCN: 有一股明显的烟味。
senses.why: A clear edge is what lets the eye rest on a thing.
senses.whyCN: 边缘清楚，眼睛才停得住。

senses.title: Clearly different
senses.definition: clearly separate and not the same as another thing
senses.definitionCN: 彼此分明，与另一物并不相同
senses.example: The two styles are distinct from each other.
senses.exampleCN: 这两种风格彼此截然不同。
senses.why: Two things stand apart only where one line is drawn between them.
senses.whyCN: 两样东西只有被一条线隔开，才显得分得清。

intro.en: Distinct is Latin distinctus, the past participle of distinguere, to separate, built on dis- and stinguere, to prick.
intro.cn: distinct 是拉丁语 distinctus，来自 distinguere（分开），由 dis- 与 stinguere（刺）构成，本义是刺出记号加以区分。

items.en: Stinguere meant to prick or mark with a point.
items.cn: stinguere 指用尖物刺或做记号。

items.en: Dis- pulled the marked pieces away from each other.
items.cn: dis- 把做过记号的几块分开。

items.en: Distinctus described what stood marked and separate.
items.cn: distinctus 描述被标记并分开放置的东西。

items.en: English used it for things clearly seen apart.
items.cn: 英语用它说清楚分得开的东西。

items.en: The sense of plain and unmistakable grew.
items.cn: 后来「明白无误」的意思壮大起来。

items.en: A distinct sound is both clear and unlike the rest.
items.cn: 今天 a distinct sound 既清楚又与众不同。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the stinguere stem, while the meaning group leans on clear edges and plain difference.
note.cn: 形近组共享 stinguere 这段词干，近义组则围绕清楚的边界与明显的差别。

entries.definition: to see or show a difference
a difference, or high quality
in a clear and unmistakable way
easy to see or understand
not joined or not the same
so plain that no one doubts it

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a sharp white line and end with two things that share no edge.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一道利落的白线开始，落到两样连边都不碰的东西。

normal.en: Dis- plus stinguere: a mark is pricked, so the two are kept apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 stinguere，刺出一道记号，两者就分开了。

normal.en: The bell gave a distinct ring across the yard.
normal.cn: 铃声在院子里响得格外清楚。

normal.en: Coffee and tea have distinct smells once you pause.
normal.cn: 停下来一闻，咖啡和茶的气味截然不同。

normal.en: Keep the two files distinct, or the proof is lost.
normal.cn: 把两份文件分开，否则证据就乱了。

normal.en: Her voice was distinct even at the back of the hall.
normal.cn: 即便在大厅后排，她的声音也很清楚。

abstract.en: Picture two white lines with a clean gap between them.
abstract.cn: 想象两条白线中间留着一道干净的缝。

abstract.en: Picture a knife cutting a sheet into two neat halves.
abstract.cn: 想象一刀把纸裁成整齐的两半。

abstract.en: Picture a mark pricked into a card to tell one from another.
abstract.cn: 想象在卡片上刺一个记号，用来认出彼此。

examples.en: There is a distinct difference between the two roads.
examples.cn: 这两条路之间有明显的区别。

examples.en: Each district keeps a distinct local accent.
examples.cn: 每个区都保留着自己独特的口音。

examples.en: The outline was distinct against the pale sky.
examples.cn: 轮廓在淡色的天空下很清楚。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distinct 记成「刺出记号」：dis 表示分开，stinct 来自刺，刺出一个记号，两样东西就看得出不同，也显得清楚。

root: 源自拉丁语 distinguere（分开），词干 stinguere 意为用尖物刺、做记号，加 dis- 表示分开。本义是刺出标记把东西区别开，因此既指界限分明、彼此不同，也指轮廓清楚、毫不含糊。

sensesIntro.en: From a mark cut to keep two things apart to an edge the eye can follow without doubt.
sensesIntro.cn: 从刺下的一道区分记号，到眼睛毫不迟疑就能跟住的边线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two white lines side by side with a clean gap that neither crosses.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条并排的白线，中间一道谁也不越过的缝。

branches.en: The first sense is clearness to the eye or ear.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是眼睛或耳朵感到的清楚。

branches.en: The second sense is clearness between two things.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是两样东西之间的分明。

branches.en: Both senses depend on an edge that can be traced.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一条能描出来的边。

branches.en: Both refuse the blur that mixes one thing into another.
branches.cn: 两个义项都拒绝把一物混成另一物的模糊。

branches.en: Only the second sense needs a second thing to compare.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项需要另一样东西来对照。

intro.en: Distinct sits in the stinguere family, where one pricked mark gives several words for separating and for clearness.
intro.cn: distinct 属于 stinguere 一族，一道刺出的记号，生出一串表示分开与清楚的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin stinguere, to prick, gives distinct and distinguish; dis- keeps the marked pieces apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stinguere（刺）给出 distinct 与 distinguish，前缀 dis- 让做过记号的几块保持分开。

items.example: A distinct line divides the fields.
items.exampleCN: 一条清楚的分界线隔开两块田。
你分得清这对双胞胎吗？

items.example: The bird has a distinctive call.
items.exampleCN: 这种鸟的叫声很有特点。

items.example: The shape was indistinct in fog.
items.exampleCN: 那形状在雾里模糊不清。

definition_en: a clear difference between two things, or a high level of quality that earns respect
core_image: 两枚几乎一样的印章，边上一处小小的刻痕分出高下
scene: 两枚印章摆在桌上，只有侧面一道细痕不同。She makes a clear distinction between work and family.
sceneCN: 这里 distinction 指「区别」（第 1 个义项：把两样东西分开来看）；句意是她把工作和家庭分得很清楚。

collocations.phrase: a clear distinction between the two

senses.title: A line drawn between two things
senses.definition: a clear difference between two things or people
senses.definitionCN: 两样东西或两个人之间明确的差别
senses.example: There is a fine distinction between the two words.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个词之间有细微的区别。
senses.why: A line thin as a hair still keeps two rooms apart.
senses.whyCN: 一根头发丝那么细的线，也能隔开两个房间。

senses.title: High standing and honour
senses.definition: excellence that earns respect, or an honour given for it
senses.definitionCN: 赢得尊重的出众，或因出众而得的荣誉
senses.example: She won distinction as a young chemist.
senses.exampleCN: 她年轻时作为化学家就赢得了声誉。
senses.why: Work that stands above the rest is given a separate name.
senses.whyCN: 高出众人的成绩，会被单独给一个名分。

intro.en: Distinction comes from Latin distinctio, a dividing, from distinguere, to separate by marking.
intro.cn: distinction 来自拉丁语 distinctio（划分），源头是 distinguere（做记号分开）。

items.en: Stinguere meant to prick a mark into a surface.
items.cn: stinguere 指在表面刺出记号。

items.en: Distinguere set the marked things apart from the rest.
items.cn: distinguere 把做过记号的东西与其余分开。

items.en: Distinctio named the dividing line itself.
items.cn: distinctio 指的就是那条分界线。

items.en: English took it as the act of telling things apart.
items.cn: 英语借入时指把事物分辨开的行为。

items.en: The sense of personal excellence appeared.
items.cn: 后来出现了个人卓越这一层意思。

items.en: A prize, a tone and a fair argument can all show distinction.
items.cn: 今天奖赏、文风与公正的论证都能显出卓越。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the marking stem, while the meaning group offers difference and praise side by side.
note.cn: 形近组共享「做记号」的词干，近义组则把差别与赞誉并排放在一起。

entries.definition: clear and clearly separate
to see or show a difference
marking something as its own
the way things are not the same
a sharp difference set side by side
entries.definitionCN: 并置时显出的鲜明差别

entries.definition: very high quality

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a hairline mark and end with a prize given for standing above the rest.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一道头发丝细的记号线开始，落到因出众而得的一个奖。

normal.en: Dis- plus stinct: a mark is pricked, and a line appears.
normal.cn: dis 加 stinct，刺出一道记号，界线就出来了。

normal.en: The distinction between the two words is easy to miss.
normal.cn: 这两个词的区别很容易被忽略。

normal.en: She served with distinction in a hard trade.
normal.cn: 她在一个艰难的行业里做得很出色。

normal.en: A good teacher draws a distinction between error and laziness.
normal.cn: 好老师会区分出错和偷懒。

normal.en: The prize added another distinction to her name.
normal.cn: 这个奖又给她的名字添了一份荣誉。

abstract.en: Picture two seals on a desk with one tiny notch apart.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上一对印章，只差一道小刻痕。

abstract.en: Picture a hairline drawn across a page, still dividing it.
abstract.cn: 想象纸上一道发丝细的线，依然把页面分开。

abstract.en: Picture a medal placed beside an ordinary cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚奖章摆在一只普通杯子旁边。

examples.en: The distinction between the two senses is small but real.
examples.cn: 两个义项之间的区别很小，却真实存在。

examples.en: He served with distinction in the navy.
examples.cn: 他在海军服役期间表现出色。

examples.en: Critics praised the distinction of her prose.
examples.cn: 评论家称赞她文笔出众。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distinction 记成「刺出分界」：dis 表示分开，stinct 来自刺，刺出一道界线，就有了区别，也指高出众人的那份卓越。

root: 源自拉丁语 distinctio，来自 distinguere（做记号分开），词干 stinguere 意为刺。本义是划出界线、把东西分辨开，后来从「分辨」引申出「出众」与「荣誉」，因为出众的人也被单独划了出来。

sensesIntro.en: From a hairline drawn between two words to the honour that marks one person above the rest.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两个词之间画出的一道细线，到把一个人标在众人之上的那份荣誉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two nearly identical seals, told apart by one small notch on the side.
core.cn: 核心意象：两枚几乎相同的印章，靠侧面一道小刻痕分开。

branches.en: The first sense is the line itself.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那条界线本身。

branches.en: The second sense is the honour that follows being set apart.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是被单独划出之后得到的荣誉。

branches.en: Both senses depend on someone noticing a difference.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖有人注意到差别。

branches.en: Both can be lost when nothing is compared.
branches.cn: 两个义项在不作比较时都无从谈起。

branches.en: Only the second sense needs public praise or a prize.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项需要公开的称赞或奖项。

intro.en: Distinction belongs to the marking family, where one pricked line yields words for difference and for fame.
intro.cn: distinction 属于「做记号」一族，一道刺出的线，长出表示差别与名声的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin stinguere, to prick, gives distinction and distinguish; dis- keeps the marked pieces apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stinguere（刺）给出 distinction 与 distinguish，前缀 dis- 让做过记号的几块保持分开。

items.meaning: the dividing line and the honour it brings
items.example: A fine distinction separates the two terms.
items.exampleCN: 两个术语之间有细微区别。

items.example: She distinguished the two voices at once.
items.exampleCN: 她一下分辨出两个声音。

definition_en: to see or explain the difference between things, or to make yourself noticed by doing well
core_image: 两片相似的叶子放在掌心，先看边缘的锯齿，再看叶脉
scene: 两片叶子几乎一样，他并排举到光下看了很久。Can you distinguish the real note from the copy?
sceneCN: 这里 distinguish 指「区分」（第 1 个义项：看出两者的差别）；句意是你能分辨真钞和假钞吗。

collocations.zh: 把一物与另一物区分开

senses.title: To tell two things apart
senses.definition: to see or explain how two things are different
senses.definitionCN: 看出或说明两样东西的不同
senses.example: Children must learn to distinguish fact from opinion.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子必须学会区分事实与看法。
senses.why: Two things only need telling apart when they look alike.
senses.whyCN: 只有长得像的东西，才需要去分辨。

senses.title: To make out with the senses
senses.definition: to manage to see, hear or recognize something faint
senses.definitionCN: 努力看清、听见或认出模糊的东西
senses.example: I could not distinguish her face in the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 在人群里我认不出她的脸。
senses.why: The eye does the same work as the mind, only faster.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛做的和脑子是同一件事，只是更快。

senses.title: To stand out by doing well
senses.definition: to make yourself noticed through good work
senses.definitionCN: 靠出色的表现让人注意到自己
senses.example: He distinguished himself in the final debate.
senses.exampleCN: 他在最后一场辩论中表现突出。
senses.why: One clear mark is enough to lift a name out of the list.
senses.whyCN: 一个清楚的记号，就足以让一个名字从名单里立起来。

intro.en: Distinguish comes from Latin distinguere, to separate by marking, from dis-, apart, and stinguere, to prick.
intro.cn: distinguish 来自拉丁语 distinguere（做记号分开），由 dis-（分开）与 stinguere（刺）构成。

items.en: Stinguere meant to prick or put a mark on something.
items.cn: stinguere 指刺一下或在东西上留记号。

items.en: Dis- carried the marked item away from its neighbours.
items.cn: dis- 把做过记号的那件从旁边的东西里分出来。

items.en: Distinguere grew to mean telling one thing from another.
items.cn: distinguere 逐渐表示把一物与另一物分辨开。

items.en: English used it for seeing a difference.
items.cn: 英语借入时表示看出差别。

items.en: The sense of standing out by merit appeared.
items.cn: 后来出现靠功绩出众的意思。

items.en: Today a good reader distinguishes tone as well as words.
items.cn: 今天好的读者既分辨字面，也分辨语气。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the marking stem, while the meaning group gathers other verbs of telling apart.
note.cn: 形近组共享「做记号」的词干，近义组则是几个表示分辨的动词。

entries.definition: clear and clearly separate
a difference, or high quality
able to be told apart
to show or see a difference
to notice something faint or subtle
