normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two leaves in one hand and end with a name lifted above the crowd.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从掌心里两片叶子开始，落到一个被举到人群之上的名字。

normal.en: Dis- plus stinguish: prick a mark, and the two come apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 stinguish，刺个记号，两者就分开了。

normal.en: A good cook can distinguish salt from sugar by touch.
normal.cn: 好厨子一摸就能分出盐和糖。

normal.en: At dusk you cannot distinguish the path from the grass.
normal.cn: 黄昏时你分不清小路和草地。

normal.en: She distinguished herself in the first round.
normal.cn: 她在第一轮就表现突出。

normal.en: Teachers distinguish effort from talent when they mark.
normal.cn: 老师批改时会区分努力与天赋。

abstract.en: Picture two leaves held up to the light, veins compared.
abstract.cn: 想象两片叶子举到光下比对叶脉。

abstract.en: Picture a mark pricked on one card among many.
abstract.cn: 想象许多卡片中有一张被刺了记号。

abstract.en: Picture one head rising above a seated crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象坐着的人群里有一个头抬得更高。

examples.en: It is hard to distinguish the two shades of blue.
examples.cn: 这两种蓝色很难分辨。

examples.en: She distinguished herself in the school choir.
examples.cn: 她在校合唱团里表现突出。

examples.en: He cannot distinguish left from right without a sign.
examples.cn: 没有标记他就分不清左右。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distinguish 记成「刺个记号分出来」：dis 表示分开，stingu 来自刺，刺上记号，就能把相似的东西分辨开，做得好还会被单独看见。

root: 源自拉丁语 distinguere，由 dis-（分开）与 stinguere（刺）组成，本义是刺出记号把东西区别开。英语先指看出差别，再指在模糊中辨认出某物，后来引申为靠出色表现让自己被单独看见。

sensesIntro.en: From telling two leaves apart to making your own name stand out of the list.
sensesIntro.cn: 从分辨两片叶子，到让自己的名字从名单里立起来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two look-alike leaves held to the light while the eyes compare their veins.
core.cn: 核心意象：两片相似的叶子举到光下，眼睛比对叶脉。

branches.en: The first sense is the work of telling two things apart.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把两样东西分辨开的工作。

branches.en: The second sense does that work with the senses alone.
branches.cn: 第二个义项只用五官来完成这件事。

branches.en: The third sense turns being noticed into being admired.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把被看见变成被称赞。

branches.en: Both senses need attention to a small difference.
branches.cn: 两个义项都需要留意细微的差别。

branches.en: Both senses depend on a mark that others can see.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖别人看得见的记号。

intro.en: Distinguish belongs to the marking family, where a pricked mark separates and also lifts a name.
intro.cn: distinguish 属于「做记号」一族，一道刺出的记号既能分开东西，也能让一个名字立起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin stinguere, to prick, gives distinguish and distinct; dis- turns one mark into a clear separation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stinguere（刺）给出 distinguish 与 distinct，前缀 dis- 把一个记号变成清楚的分隔。

items.example: Can you distinguish the two inks?
items.exampleCN: 你分得出这两种墨水吗？

items.example: The distinction is easy to miss.
items.exampleCN: 这个区别很容易被忽略。

items.example: Her only distinguishing mark is a scar.
items.exampleCN: 她唯一可辨的标记是一道疤。

definition_en: something that takes your attention away from what you are doing, or a pleasant way to pass the time
core_image: 书页边上晃过一只飞蛾，眼睛跟着它走了半行
scene: 台灯下刚写两行，窗玻璃上扑来一只飞蛾。The phone on the desk is a constant distraction.
sceneCN: 这里 distraction 指「让人分心的事物」（第 1 个义项：把注意力拉走的东西）；句意是桌上那部手机总让人分心。

senses.title: Something that pulls the mind away
senses.definition: a thing or person that takes your attention from what you are doing
senses.definitionCN: 把你注意力从手头事情上拉走的东西或人
senses.example: Loud music is a distraction when I study.
senses.exampleCN: 我学习时大声的音乐就是一种干扰。
senses.why: Attention is a single thread, and any hand can tug it.
senses.whyCN: 注意力只有一根线，谁伸手都能拽一下。

senses.title: A pleasant way to pass time
senses.definition: an activity that keeps the mind amused or calm
senses.definitionCN: 让心思得到消遣或安静下来的活动
senses.example: The market was a happy distraction for the children.
senses.exampleCN: 集市对孩子们来说是个开心的消遣。
senses.why: The same pulling hand is welcome when the task is dull.
senses.whyCN: 事情枯燥时，那只拉走注意力的手反倒受欢迎。

intro.en: Distraction comes from Latin distrahere, to pull apart, from dis-, apart, and trahere, to draw.
intro.cn: distraction 来自拉丁语 distrahere（拉开），由 dis-（分开）与 trahere（拉）构成。

items.en: Trahere meant to draw or drag something along.
items.cn: trahere 指拉动或拖着东西走。

items.en: Dis- pulled the mind in more than one direction.
items.cn: dis- 把心思往好几个方向拉。

items.en: Distractio named the state of being pulled apart.
items.cn: distractio 指被拉散的状态。

items.en: English used it for a mind torn between things.
items.cn: 英语借入时指心思被扯成几块。

items.en: The milder sense of amusement took hold.
items.cn: 后来较温和的「消遣」义站稳了脚。

items.en: A screen, a sound and a worry are all distractions today.
items.cn: 今天的屏幕、声响与心事都算分心之物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the trahere stem, while the meaning group lists other breaks in attention.
note.cn: 形近组共享 trahere 这段词干，近义组则是几种打断注意力的情形。

entries.definition: to pull attention away
unable to keep the mind on one thing
entries.definitionCN: 无法把心思集中在一处

entries.definition: likely to pull attention away
something that breaks the quiet
a sudden break in what is happening
entries.definitionCN: 正在进行之事被突然打断

entries.definition: a gentle way to pass the time

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a moth on the window and end with a dull afternoon made lighter.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从窗上的一只飞蛾开始，落到一个被照亮一点的沉闷下午。

normal.en: Dis- plus tract: the mind is pulled apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 tract，心思就被往两边拉开。

normal.en: A single message can be a distraction for a whole hour.
normal.cn: 一条消息就能让人分心整整一小时。

normal.en: Turn the phone face down and the distraction goes quiet.
normal.cn: 把手机扣过去，分心之物就安静了。

normal.en: The market gave the children a welcome distraction.
normal.cn: 集市给了孩子们一段愉快的消遣。

normal.en: Too many distractions make a short task long.
normal.cn: 分心的事一多，短活也拖成长活。

abstract.en: Picture a moth crossing the page while the eyes follow it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只飞蛾掠过纸面，眼睛跟着它走。

abstract.en: Picture a hand tugging one thread out of a neat row.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从整齐的一排里抽走一根线。

abstract.en: Picture a noisy room fading when a favourite song starts.
abstract.cn: 想象喜爱的歌一起，吵闹的房间就退远了。

examples.en: The noise outside was a constant distraction.
examples.cn: 外面的噪声让人一直分心。

examples.en: She worked for an hour without distractions.
examples.cn: 她心无旁骛地工作了一个小时。

examples.en: A walk in the park offered a welcome distraction.
examples.cn: 去公园走走成了一段愉快的消遣。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distraction 记成「被拉走的心思」：dis 表示分开，tract 表示拉，心思被往旁边一拉，就有了让人分心的事，也可能是一段消遣。

root: 源自拉丁语 distrahere（拉开），由 dis-（分开）与 trahere（拉）组成。本义是把人的心思往不同方向拉扯，因此指打断注意力的东西；当拉扯来自愉快之事时，又引申为消遣与解闷。

sensesIntro.en: From a moth crossing the page to a dull hour made lighter by something pleasant.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一只飞蛾掠过纸面，到一段因愉快之事而变轻的沉闷时光。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a moth crossing the page while the eyes follow it away from the line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只飞蛾掠过纸面，眼睛跟着它离开原来那一行。

branches.en: The first sense is any pull that steals attention.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是任何偷走注意力的拉扯。

branches.en: The second sense is a pull that is welcome.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是受欢迎的拉扯。

branches.en: Both senses move the mind off its present task.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把心思从眼前的事上移开。

branches.en: Both are judged by what the mind leaves behind.
branches.cn: 两个义项都看心思离开了什么来评判。

branches.en: Only the second sense leaves a pleasant memory.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项留下愉快的记忆。

intro.en: Distraction sits in the trahere family, where Latin trahere, to draw, meets several prefixes.
intro.cn: distraction 属于 trahere 一族，中心是拉丁语 trahere（拉），前后接上不同前缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere, to draw, gives distraction, attract and extract; the prefix decides which way the pull goes.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere（拉）给出 distraction、attract 与 extract，前缀决定往哪个方向拉。

items.example: The phone is a constant distraction.

items.meaning: the grip of a wheel on a surface
items.example: The tyres lost traction on ice.
items.exampleCN: 轮胎在冰上失去抓地力。

definition_en: great pain or worry, a situation of serious danger, or to make someone suffer
core_image: 夜里电话铃突然响起，人从床上坐直，手心发凉
scene: 半夜铃声把他叫醒，听完一句话就坐在床沿发呆。The ship sent a distress signal at dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 distress 指「困境、危急」（第 2 个义项：处于危险而需要救援）；句意是那艘船在黎明时发出了求救信号。

senses.title: Great pain or worry
senses.definition: great pain, sorrow or worry of mind
senses.definitionCN: 心里极度的疼痛、悲伤或忧虑
senses.example: Her face showed real distress.
senses.exampleCN: 她脸上露出真正的痛苦。
senses.why: Pain that has nowhere to go settles in the whole body.
senses.whyCN: 无处可去的痛，会沉到整个身体里。

senses.title: Serious danger or need
senses.definition: a situation of great danger in which help is needed
senses.definitionCN: 处境危险而急需帮助
senses.example: The boat was in distress off the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 那艘船在近海遇险。
senses.why: A call for help turns private pain into a public fact.
senses.whyCN: 一声呼救，把私人的痛变成众人皆知的事。

senses.title: To make someone suffer
senses.definition: to cause someone pain, sorrow or worry
senses.definitionCN: 使某人疼痛、悲伤或忧虑
senses.example: The news distressed the whole family.
senses.exampleCN: 这个消息让全家人都很痛苦。
senses.why: Sorrow crosses a room faster than any explanation.
senses.whyCN: 悲伤穿过一间屋，比任何解释都快。

intro.en: Distress comes from Latin distringere, to pull tight, from dis- and stringere, to draw or bind.
intro.cn: distress 来自拉丁语 distringere（拉紧），由 dis- 与 stringere（勒紧、捆绑）构成。

items.en: Stringere meant to draw tight or bind hard.
items.cn: stringere 指勒紧或紧紧捆住。

items.en: Dis- pulled the binding in opposite ways.
items.cn: dis- 把束缚往相反方向扯。

items.en: Distringere described being stretched and squeezed at once.
items.cn: distringere 描绘同时被拉扯与挤压。

items.en: Destresse named the tight, painful state.
items.cn: 古法语 destresse 指那种紧绷而痛苦的状态。

items.en: English used it for sorrow and for danger at sea.
items.cn: 英语借入后既指悲伤，也指海上的险情。

items.en: Today a signal, a debt and a loss can all bring distress.
items.cn: 今天求救信号、债务与失去都可能带来痛苦。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the stringere stem, while the meaning group gathers words for deep pain and hard times.
note.cn: 形近组共享 stringere 这段词干，近义组则聚起表示深痛与艰难的词。

entries.definition: pressure or worry under load
feeling under too much pressure
full of pain and worry
the state of going through pain
very severe mental pain
a life made hard by lack or trouble
entries.definitionCN: 因匮乏或困难而艰难的生活

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a phone ringing at night and end with a ship asking the shore for help.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从夜里响起的电话开始，落到一艘向岸边求救的船。

normal.en: Dis- plus stress: pressure pulled two ways becomes pain.
normal.cn: dis 加 stress，压力被两头一扯就成了痛苦。

normal.en: A letter from the bank threw her into distress.
normal.cn: 银行来的一封信让她陷入痛苦。

normal.en: The crew in distress fired a red light into the sky.
normal.cn: 遇险的船员朝天空放了一颗红色信号。

normal.en: The crying child distressed the whole carriage.
normal.cn: 哭着的孩子让整节车厢都不安。

normal.en: Debt can cause more distress than a bad day.
normal.cn: 债务带来的痛苦可能超过糟糕的一天。

abstract.en: Picture a rope pulled tight until the fibres start to part.
abstract.cn: 想象一根绳子被拉紧，纤维开始分离。

abstract.en: Picture a hand on a phone at three in the morning.
abstract.cn: 想象凌晨三点，一只手按在电话上。

abstract.en: Picture a small boat sending one red light into the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一只小船向黑暗里放出一盏红灯。

examples.en: The letter caused her great distress.
examples.cn: 那封信让她非常痛苦。

examples.en: The crew was in distress near the rocks.
examples.cn: 船员在礁石附近遇险。

examples.en: The news distressed everyone at the table.
examples.cn: 这个消息让桌边所有人都很难受。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distress 记成「被拉紧的痛」：dis 表示分开，stress 与勒紧同源，绳子两头一扯，人就又痛又慌，也会让身边人跟着难受。

root: 源自拉丁语 distringere（拉紧），由 dis- 与 stringere（勒紧、捆绑）组成，经古法语 destresse 进入英语。本义是被拉扯、被挤压的紧绷状态，后来指心里的痛苦，也指海上等处的危急处境。

sensesIntro.en: From a rope pulled tight to a ship asking the shore for help in the dark.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一根被拉紧的绳子，到黑暗里向岸边求救的一艘船。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a phone ringing at night, and a body sitting up before the words arrive.
core.cn: 核心意象：夜里电话响起，话还没听完，人已经从床上坐直。

branches.en: The first sense is the inner pain of being pulled tight.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是被拉紧之后心里的痛。

branches.en: The second sense is the outward danger that demands rescue.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是需要救援的外在险境。

branches.en: The third sense passes the pain to someone else.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把痛苦传到别人身上。

branches.en: Both senses move pain between people.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让痛苦在人与人之间移动。

branches.en: Only the second sense needs a signal and a rescuer.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项需要信号与救援者。

intro.en: Distress belongs to the stringere family, where Latin stringere, to draw tight, runs through stress and strict.
intro.cn: distress 属于 stringere 一族，拉丁语 stringere（拉紧）贯穿 stress 与 strict。

latinIntro.en: Latin stringere, to draw tight, gives stress and strict; dis- and con- tighten it in different directions.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stringere（拉紧）给出 stress 与 strict，前缀 dis- 与 con- 把紧绷推向不同方向。

items.meaning: to pull tight until it hurts
items.exampleCN: 这次失去带来深重的痛苦。

items.meaning: pressure put on a thing or a mind
items.example: Too much stress spoiled his sleep.
items.exampleCN: 压力太大毁了他的睡眠。

items.example: The school is strict about lateness.
items.exampleCN: 这所学校对迟到很严格。

items.example: The rules put a restriction on noise.

items.meaning: an area drawn off from the rest
items.example: The old district keeps its narrow lanes.
The rope strained under the weight.

definition_en: to give things out to people, or to spread them over an area
core_image: 一叠传单从怀里抽出，一张张递到不同的手上
scene: 门口排起了队，他把传单一张张递过去。Volunteers distribute blankets to every family.
sceneCN: 这里 distribute 指「分发」（第 1 个义项：把东西分给各人）；句意是志愿者把毯子分给每一家。

senses.title: To give a share to each
senses.definition: to give part of something to each person or place
senses.definitionCN: 把东西的一部分给到每个人或每处
senses.example: They distributed the blankets at the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在大门口分发毯子。
senses.why: A pile becomes fair only when it is handed out.
senses.whyCN: 一堆东西只有分到手上，才谈得上公平。

senses.title: To spread across an area
senses.definition: to spread something over an area or among groups
senses.definitionCN: 把东西散在一整片地方或人群里
senses.example: The seeds are distributed by the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 种子靠风散开。
senses.why: What is scattered stops belonging to one place.
senses.whyCN: 散开的东西，就不再只属于一处。

intro.en: Distribute comes from Latin distribuere, to deal out, from dis-, apart, and tribuere, to assign.
intro.cn: distribute 来自拉丁语 distribuere（分派），由 dis-（分开）与 tribuere（分给）构成。

items.en: Tribuere meant to assign or grant a share.
items.cn: tribuere 指分派或给予一份。

items.en: Dis- sent the shares to different hands.
items.cn: dis- 把各份送到不同的人手里。

items.en: Distribuere covered both giving out and spreading.
items.cn: distribuere 既指分发，也指铺开。

items.en: English used it for sharing goods among people.
items.cn: 英语借入时指把物品分给众人。

items.en: The sense of spreading over land grew common.
items.cn: 后来「散布在土地上」的用法普遍起来。

items.en: Today a company distributes films as well as parcels.
items.cn: 今天公司既配送包裹，也发行影片。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the tribuere stem, while the meaning group gathers other ways of giving out.
note.cn: 形近组共享 tribuere 这段词干，近义组则是几种把东西给出去的说法。

entries.definition: the act of giving out or spreading
a person or firm that passes goods on
entries.definitionCN: 把货物转送出去的经销商

entries.definition: to give a share to a common pool
entries.definitionCN: 为共同的一份出一份力

entries.definition: to give out for a stated purpose
to cover a wider and wider area
to carry goods to a place

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a stack of papers and end with seeds carried far by wind.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一叠纸开始，落到被风带得很远的种子。

normal.en: Dis- plus tribute: each share goes to a different hand.
normal.cn: dis 加 tribute，每一份都送到不同的人手里。

normal.en: Helpers distributed water along the whole route.
normal.cn: 帮手沿整条路线分发饮水。

normal.en: The weight must be distributed over both legs.
normal.cn: 重量要分到两条腿上。

normal.en: This plant is distributed across the whole south.
normal.cn: 这种植物遍布整个南方。

normal.en: The firm distributes its goods by rail.
normal.cn: 这家公司用铁路配送货物。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of leaflets leaving one hand for many.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠传单从一只手里分到许多手上。

abstract.en: Picture seeds let go and carried off in all directions.
abstract.cn: 想象种子被放开，朝四面散去。

abstract.en: Picture a map dotted with the same mark again and again.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图上同一个标记点了一次又一次。

examples.en: The teacher distributed the papers at the door.
examples.cn: 老师在门口把试卷发下去。

examples.en: Rainfall is distributed evenly across the region.
examples.cn: 降雨均匀分布在整个地区。

examples.en: The charity distributes meals every evening.
examples.cn: 这家慈善机构每天晚上分发饭菜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distribute 记成「分开给」：dis 表示分开，tribute 表示给，分开来给，就是分发；东西分到各处，也就成了分布。

root: 源自拉丁语 distribuere，由 dis-（分开）与 tribuere（分给、分派）组成。本义是把一份份东西分给不同的人，后来也指把事物铺展到一片地方，于是兼有「分发」与「分布」两层意思。

sensesIntro.en: From a share placed in each hand to a pattern of marks spread across a map.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一份份放进各人手里，到散在整张地图上的标记。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of leaflets leaving one hand and arriving in many.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠传单从一只手里离开，落到许多只手上。

branches.en: The first sense is the act of handing out shares.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把一份份递出去的动作。

branches.en: The second sense is the pattern left after spreading.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是散开之后留下的样子。

branches.en: Both senses start with one source and end in many places.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从一处出发，落到许多地方。

branches.en: Both can be even or badly uneven.
branches.cn: 两个义项都可能是均匀的，也可能很不均。

branches.en: Only the second sense can be drawn on a map.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项能画在地图上。

intro.en: Distribute belongs to the tribuere family, where Latin tribuere, to assign, meets several prefixes.
intro.cn: distribute 属于 tribuere 一族，中心是拉丁语 tribuere（分给），前后接上不同前缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin tribuere, to assign, gives tribute and contribute; dis- spreads the shares apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tribuere（分给）给出 tribute 与 contribute，前缀 dis- 把各份分送开来。

items.meaning: to hand out shares to many
the act or pattern of giving out
items.example: The distribution of rainfall is uneven.
A local distributor handles the stock.
The job has a distributive side.
items.exampleCN: 这份工作有分配的一面。
这个方案重新分配土地。

items.meaning: to give into a common pool
to assign a cause or quality
items.example: She attributes her win to luck.

items.meaning: a gift given to show respect
items.example: The song is a tribute to her teacher.
items.exampleCN: 这首歌是献给老师的敬意。

definition_en: the act of giving things out to many people, or the way things are spread over an area
core_image: 一张地图上散着许多小点，越靠中间越密
scene: 地图铺在桌上，小点东一堆西一堆。The distribution of rainfall is uneven this year.
sceneCN: 这里 distribution 指「分布」（第 2 个义项：散在各处的状况）；句意是今年的降雨分布很不均匀。

senses.title: The act of giving out
senses.definition: the act of giving parts of something to many people
senses.definitionCN: 把东西一份份给许多人的行为
senses.example: The distribution of blankets began at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 分发毯子在中午开始。
senses.why: Fairness lives in the moment each share leaves the pile.
senses.whyCN: 公平就藏在每一份离开那堆东西的那一刻。

senses.title: The way things are spread
senses.definition: the pattern in which things are placed over an area
senses.definitionCN: 事物在一片地方上摆开的格局
senses.example: The map shows the distribution of rainfall.
senses.exampleCN: 这张图显示降雨的分布。
senses.why: A pattern is only visible when you step back from the dots.
senses.whyCN: 退后一步，才看得见许多点排成的样子。

senses.title: The business of delivering goods
senses.definition: the work of storing goods and sending them to shops
senses.definitionCN: 把货物存放并送到店铺的工作
senses.example: He works in distribution for a food company.
senses.exampleCN: 他在一家食品公司做配送。
senses.why: Someone must move the box from the factory to the shelf.
senses.whyCN: 总得有人把箱子从工厂搬到货架上。

intro.en: Distribution is Latin distributio, a dealing out, from distribuere, to assign in parts.
intro.cn: distribution 是拉丁语 distributio（分派），来自 distribuere（按份分给）。

items.en: Tribuere meant to grant a person a share.
items.cn: tribuere 指分给某人一份。

items.en: Dis- marked the splitting of one whole into parts.
items.cn: dis- 标出一个整体被分成几份。

items.en: Distributio named the settled pattern of shares.
items.cn: distributio 指分好之后形成的格局。

items.en: English used it for the sharing of goods.
items.cn: 英语借入时指物品的分配。

items.en: Trade gave it the sense of moving goods to shops.
items.cn: 商业让它有了把货运到店铺的意思。

items.en: Today it covers wealth, rainfall and parcel routes.
items.cn: 今天它可以指财富、降雨，也指包裹路线。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the tribute stem, while the meaning group names other patterns of sharing.
note.cn: 形近组共享 tribute 这段词干，近义组则是几种分配与铺开的名目。

entries.definition: to give out in shares
a firm that passes goods to shops
entries.definitionCN: 把货物转给店铺的经销商

entries.definition: concerned with sharing out
an amount set aside for a purpose
the reach of something over an area
the carrying of goods to a place

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with dots on a map and end with a van unloading boxes at a shop door.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从地图上的小点开始，落到一辆车在店门口卸货。

normal.en: Dis- plus tribute plus -ion: the sharing has become a pattern.
normal.cn: dis 加 tribute 再加 ion，分配成了一种格局。

normal.en: The distribution of seats favours the big cities.
normal.cn: 席位的分配偏向大城市。

normal.en: An even distribution of weight keeps the table steady.
normal.cn: 重量分布均匀，桌子才稳。

normal.en: The company rebuilt its distribution after the flood.
normal.cn: 洪水之后公司重建了配送网络。

normal.en: Income distribution is the subject of the whole report.
normal.cn: 整份报告讲的是收入分配。

abstract.en: Picture dots scattered on a map, thick in the middle.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上散着许多点，中间最密。

abstract.en: Picture one pile divided carefully into equal shares.
abstract.cn: 想象一堆东西被仔细分成相等的几份。

abstract.en: Picture a van leaving a warehouse before sunrise.
abstract.cn: 想象天没亮，一辆车开出仓库。

examples.en: The distribution of the prizes took only ten minutes.
examples.cn: 发奖只用了十分钟。

examples.en: The map shows the distribution of the species.
examples.cn: 这张图显示了该物种的分布。

examples.en: She found work in distribution after college.
examples.cn: 她大学毕业后在配送行业找到了工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distribution 记成「分开给开的样子」：dis 表示分开，tribute 表示给，加上名词尾，既指分发这件事，也指分完之后散开的格局。

root: 源自拉丁语 distributio，来自 distribuere（按份分给），由 dis-（分开）与 tribuere（分给）构成。本义是把一份份分出去，后来指分完之后呈现的格局，于是兼有「分配」与「分布」两义，现代又添了货物配送的意思。

sensesIntro.en: From shares leaving a pile to a pattern of dots that only appears when you step back.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一份份离开那堆东西，到退后一步才看得见的点点格局。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many small dots scattered on a map, thickest near the middle.
core.cn: 核心意象：地图上散着许多小点，越靠中间越密。

branches.en: The first sense is the act of handing out shares.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把一份份发出去的动作。

branches.en: The second sense is the pattern those shares make.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是这些份数排出的格局。

branches.en: The third sense is the trade that moves goods to shops.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把货运到店铺的行业。

branches.en: Both senses concern how a whole is divided.
branches.cn: 两个义项都关乎一个整体怎样被分开。

branches.en: Both senses can be shown on a map of routes.
branches.cn: 两个义项都能画在路线图上。

intro.en: Distribution sits in the tribuere family, where Latin tribuere, to assign, gives a whole set of sharing words.
intro.cn: distribution 属于 tribuere 一族，拉丁语 tribuere（分给）生出一整组表示分配的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin tribuere, to assign, gives tribute and contribute; the suffix -ion turns the act into a pattern.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tribuere（分给）给出 tribute 与 contribute，后缀 -ion 把动作变成一种格局。

items.meaning: the act or pattern of sharing out

items.exampleCN: 这家经销商覆盖三个省。

items.meaning: to give into a common pool

items.example: He attributes the delay to rain.
They paid tribute to the old coach.

definition_en: an area of a town or country with its own name, border or purpose
core_image: 老城地图上被街道围出的一小块，边线像铅笔轻轻描过
scene: 地图上用铅笔围出一小块，四条街正好当边。The old district keeps its narrow lanes.
sceneCN: 这里 district 指「城区」（第 1 个义项：城市里划分出的一片区域）；句意是老城区保留着窄巷。

senses.title: A part of a town
senses.definition: a part of a city or town, often with its own name or character
senses.definitionCN: 城市里的一片地方，常有自己的名字或特点
senses.example: They moved to a quiet district near the river.
senses.exampleCN: 他们搬到河边一个安静的城区。
senses.why: A city becomes readable once its parts are named.
senses.whyCN: 城市被分成有名字的几块，才读得懂。

senses.title: An area marked for a purpose
senses.definition: an area of a country set apart for a particular use or rule
senses.definitionCN: 为一个用途或一套规则划出的一片地方
senses.example: The mining district employs thousands.
senses.exampleCN: 矿区雇了成千上万人。
senses.why: A border on a map is a decision before it is a place.
senses.whyCN: 地图上的界线，先是一个决定，然后才是一个地方。

intro.en: District comes from Latin districtus, a territory under a lord, from distringere, to draw tight.
intro.cn: district 来自拉丁语 districtus（辖地），源头是 distringere（拉紧、约束）。

items.en: Stringere meant to draw tight or bind.
items.cn: stringere 指拉紧或捆住。

items.en: Distringere added the sense of holding under control.
items.cn: distringere 添上管住、约束的意思。

items.en: Districtus named the land held under one authority.
items.cn: districtus 指归一个权力管辖的土地。

items.en: Old French districte kept the legal flavour.
items.cn: 古法语 districte 保留了法律意味。

items.en: English widened it to any marked part of a place.
items.cn: 英语后来把它扩大到任何划出的一片地方。

items.en: A school, a shop and a mine can each have a district.
items.cn: 今天学校、商店与矿山都可以有自己的区。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the strict stem, while the meaning group lists other names for a piece of land.
note.cn: 形近组共享 strict 这段词干，近义组则是几种表示一片地方的说法。

entries.definition: firm and not allowing exceptions
to keep within limits
a rule that limits something
a part of a place with no clear edge
entries.definitionCN: 一片边界不明确的地方

entries.definition: a large part of a country
an area marked off for one use
entries.definitionCN: 为某种用途划出的地带

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a pencil line around four streets and end with a mine that has its own name.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从围着四条街的铅笔线开始，落到一座有自己的名字的矿。

normal.en: Dis- plus strict: a line is drawn tight around a piece of land.
normal.cn: dis 加 strict，一根线把一片地紧紧圈住。

normal.en: The market district is loud until midnight.
normal.cn: 市场区一直吵到半夜。

normal.en: Every district sends one teacher to the meeting.
normal.cn: 每个区派一名老师来开会。

normal.en: The school district redrew its borders last year.
normal.cn: 学区去年重画了边界。

normal.en: Coal built this district and then left it quiet.
normal.cn: 煤把这个区建起来，然后让它安静下来。

abstract.en: Picture a pencil square drawn around four streets.
abstract.cn: 想象用铅笔围着四条街画一个方块。

abstract.en: Picture a gate with a name board above it.
abstract.cn: 想象一道门，门楣上挂着一块名牌。

abstract.en: Picture a map cut into pieces by thin lines.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图被细线切成几块。

examples.en: The old district is full of small bookshops.
examples.cn: 老城区到处都是小书店。

examples.en: She works in the business district near the station.
examples.cn: 她在车站附近的商业区上班。

examples.en: Each district has its own fire station.
examples.cn: 每个区都有自己的消防站。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 district 记成「圈起来的一片」：dis 表示分开，strict 表示拉紧，用线把一片地紧紧圈出，就成了一个区。

root: 源自拉丁语 districtus，来自 distringere（拉紧、约束），本义是被一个权力圈住、受其管辖的一片土地。后来法律意味变淡，只指在地图上划出的一片地方，可用于城区、学区、矿区等。

sensesIntro.en: From a line drawn tight around four streets to a whole region with its own name board.
sensesIntro.cn: 从绕着四条街紧紧画出的一根线，到一整片挂着自己名牌的地区。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small square on an old town map, outlined in pencil along four streets.
core.cn: 核心意象：老城地图上用铅笔沿四条街描出的一小块。

chain: A NAME IS PUT ON IT

branches.en: The first sense is a named part of a town.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是城市里有名字的一片。

branches.en: The second sense is land marked off for a use.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是为某种用途划出的地。

branches.en: Both senses are made by a line someone decided on.
branches.cn: 两个义项都靠某人决定的一条线成立。

branches.en: Both give the people inside a shared name.
branches.cn: 两个义项都给里面的人一个共同的名字。

branches.en: Only the second sense suggests a single industry or rule.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项暗示单一的行业或规则。

intro.en: District belongs to the strict family, where Latin stringere, to draw tight, also gives strict and restrict.
intro.cn: district 属于 strict 一族，拉丁语 stringere（拉紧）也给出 strict 与 restrict。

latinIntro.en: Latin stringere, to draw tight, gives strict; dis- encloses a piece of land under one authority.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stringere（拉紧）给出 strict，前缀 dis- 把一片地圈在一个权力之下。

items.meaning: land drawn tight under one rule
items.example: The district has its own council.
A restriction on water use began.

items.meaning: in a firm and exact way

definition_en: to interrupt someone, to make someone worried, or to move something out of its place
core_image: 门缝里透出灯光，一只手抬到门边又停住
scene: 他抬手要敲门，看见门缝里的灯还亮着。Please do not disturb the patient after ten.
sceneCN: 这里 disturb 指「打扰」（第 1 个义项：打断别人正在做的事）；句意是十点以后请不要打扰病人。

collocations.phrase: disturb the papers on the desk

senses.title: To break into someone's work
senses.definition: to interrupt someone who is busy or resting
senses.definitionCN: 打断正在做事或休息的人
senses.example: Do not disturb him while he is writing.
senses.exampleCN: 他写东西的时候别去打扰。
senses.why: A closed door is a small promise that the work continues.
senses.whyCN: 一扇关着的门，是工作还在继续的小小承诺。

senses.title: To make someone uneasy
senses.definition: to make someone feel worried or upset
senses.definitionCN: 让人感到忧虑或难受
senses.example: The quiet in the house disturbed her.
senses.exampleCN: 屋里的安静让她不安。
senses.why: A silence can press harder than a loud voice.
senses.whyCN: 沉默有时比大声说话更压人。

senses.title: To move something out of place
senses.definition: to move or change something that should be left alone
senses.definitionCN: 动了本该原样放着的东西
senses.example: Someone had disturbed the papers on the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 有人动过桌上的纸。
senses.why: A moved object leaves a shadow of its former place.
senses.whyCN: 被挪动的东西，会留下原位的影子。

intro.en: Disturb comes from Latin disturbare, from dis-, apart, and turbare, to throw into disorder.
intro.cn: disturb 来自拉丁语 disturbare，由 dis-（分开）与 turbare（搅乱）构成。

items.en: Turba meant a crowd or a noisy confusion.
items.cn: turba 指人群或喧闹的混乱。

items.en: Turbare meant to stir that confusion up.
items.cn: turbare 指把这种混乱搅起来。

items.en: Dis- added the sense of scattering what was settled.
items.cn: dis- 加上把安定之物打散的意思。

items.en: Disturbare described driving a calm crowd into disorder.
items.cn: disturbare 描绘把安静的人群搅乱。

items.en: English used it for breaking another person's quiet.
items.cn: 英语借入时指打破别人的安静。

items.en: Today a noise, a worry or a moved chair can disturb.
items.cn: 今天噪声、忧虑或一把挪动的椅子都能打扰人。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the turbare stem, while the meaning group gathers other ways of breaking in.
note.cn: 形近组共享 turbare 这段词干，近义组则是几种闯入别人状态的说法。

entries.definition: a break in the quiet or order
worried, or not at ease
making people uneasy
to annoy or trouble someone lightly
to cut into what is being said or done
to make someone unhappy or worried

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a hand paused at a lit door and end with papers shifted on a desk.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只手停在亮着灯的门前开始，落到桌上被挪动过的纸。

normal.en: Dis- plus turb: the calm is stirred into a mess.
normal.cn: dis 加 turb，平静被搅成一团乱。

normal.en: A sign on the door says do not disturb.
normal.cn: 门上挂着一块牌子，写着请勿打扰。

normal.en: The noise outside disturbed her sleep again.
normal.cn: 外面的响声又打扰了她的睡眠。

normal.en: What he saw in the yard disturbed him for days.
normal.cn: 他在院子里看到的东西让他不安了好几天。

normal.en: Do not disturb the wet paint on the rail.
normal.cn: 别碰栏杆上还没干的漆。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised to knock, then held still.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手抬起要敲，又停住不动。

abstract.en: Picture a calm pond struck once by a stone.
abstract.cn: 想象平静的池塘被一块石头砸了一下。

abstract.en: Picture a neat pile of papers slid out of line.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠整齐的纸被推歪了。

examples.en: Please do not disturb the class during the test.
examples.cn: 考试期间请不要打扰这个班。

examples.en: The letter disturbed her more than she admitted.
examples.cn: 这封信让她不安，只是她不肯承认。

examples.en: Someone had disturbed the soil near the wall.
examples.cn: 有人动过墙边的土。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 disturb 记成「把平静搅散」：dis 表示分开，turb 表示搅乱，好好的一团安静被搅散，就是打扰，也会让人心里发慌。

root: 源自拉丁语 disturbare，由 dis-（分开）与 turbare（搅乱）组成，turbare 又来自 turba（人群、喧闹）。本义是把安静的人群搅乱，后来泛指打断别人的安宁，也指搅乱心思与挪动物件。

sensesIntro.en: From a calm crowd stirred into noise to a neat desk left slightly out of line.
sensesIntro.cn: 从安静的人群被搅成喧闹，到整齐的桌面被弄得略微错位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand raised to knock, stopping because the light is on.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手抬起要敲，看见灯还亮着便停住。

branches.en: The first sense is a break in someone's activity.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是打断别人正在做的事。

branches.en: The second sense is a break in someone's calm.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是打破别人心里的平静。

branches.en: The third sense is a break in the order of things.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是打破物件的原有秩序。

branches.en: Both senses reach a person who did not ask for it.
branches.cn: 两个义项都触到一个并未邀请的人。

branches.en: Both senses can be undone by leaving things alone.
branches.cn: 两个义项都能靠不动手来避免。

intro.en: Disturb belongs to the turbare family, where Latin turba, a crowd, gives words for confusion and trouble.
intro.cn: disturb 属于 turbare 一族，拉丁语 turba（人群）生出表示混乱与麻烦的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin turbare, to throw into disorder, gives disturb and turbulent; dis- scatters the settled calm.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 turbare（搅乱）给出 disturb 与 turbulent，前缀 dis- 把安定的平静打散。

items.meaning: the state or act of being disturbed

items.example: She looked disturbed by the call.
items.exampleCN: 那通电话让她显得不安。

items.meaning: thick and unclear, as muddy water
items.example: The river ran turbid after rain.

definition_en: a long narrow channel dug in the ground, or to throw something away
core_image: 路边一道被雨水灌满的浅沟，水面漂着几片叶子
scene: 雨停在傍晚，路边那道浅沟里还积着水。The car slid into a ditch beside the road.
sceneCN: 这里 ditch 指「沟渠」（第 1 个义项：地上挖出的窄沟）；句意是车子滑进了路边的沟里。

senses.title: A narrow channel in the ground
senses.definition: a long narrow hole dug beside a road or field to carry water
senses.definitionCN: 在路边或田边挖出的窄沟，用来排水或引水
senses.example: Rain water ran along the ditch.
senses.exampleCN: 雨水顺着沟流走。
senses.why: A ditch is a line the ground agrees to keep open.
senses.whyCN: 沟是地面答应一直敞开的一道线。

senses.title: To throw something away
senses.definition: to get rid of something you no longer want
senses.definitionCN: 把不再需要的东西丢掉
senses.example: They ditched the old plan without a word.
senses.exampleCN: 他们一句话没说就把旧计划扔了。
senses.why: Letting go is faster when nobody is watching.
senses.whyCN: 没人看着的时候，放手总是更快。

intro.en: Ditch comes from Old English dic, a trench or dike, a word older than written English.
intro.cn: ditch 来自古英语 dic（沟、堤），这个词比有记载的英语还要早。

items.en: Dic meant a dug trench or a raised bank.
items.cn: dic 指挖出的沟或筑起的堤。

items.en: Farmers cut dics to lead water off wet fields.
items.cn: 农人挖沟把水从湿田里引走。

items.en: The spelling settled as dich and then ditch.
items.cn: 拼写先作 dich，后来固定为 ditch。

items.en: Roadside ditches became a common sight in law and travel.
items.cn: 路边沟在律法与时人游记里成了常见之物。

items.en: The verb appeared with the sense of getting rid of.
items.cn: 动词形式出现了「甩掉」的意思。

items.en: Today a pilot can ditch a plane and a person can ditch a habit.
items.cn: 今天飞机可以迫降，人也可以戒掉一个习惯。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by a single starting sound, while the meaning group names other dug channels.
note.cn: 形近组只差开头一个音，近义组则是几种挖出来的通道。

entries.definition: a field for sport, or a high tone
a small piece of ground or cloth
one loop of thread in sewing
a long deep ditch
a passage cut for water
a pipe or ditch that carries water away

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a wet line beside a road and end with a plan quietly dropped.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从路边一道湿痕开始，落到一个被悄悄放下的计划。

normal.en: Ditch and dig share the same old root: a ditch is ground dug open.
normal.cn: ditch 与 dig 同源，沟就是把地挖开。

normal.en: The tractor stopped with one wheel in the ditch.
normal.cn: 拖拉机停下时一个轮子陷在沟里。

normal.en: A ditch along the field keeps the roots dry.
normal.cn: 田边的沟让根不被泡着。

normal.en: He ditched the meeting and went home.
normal.cn: 他放掉了那个会，回家去了。

normal.en: They ditched the old van by the river.
normal.cn: 他们把旧货车扔在河边。

abstract.en: Picture a thin line of water beside a dusty road.
abstract.cn: 想象一条土路旁细细的一道水。

abstract.en: Picture a spade cutting a neat channel through grass.
abstract.cn: 想象铁锹在草里切出一条整齐的沟。

abstract.en: Picture a key dropped into a drawer and forgotten.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙被丢进抽屉再没人想起。

examples.en: The tractor slid into a ditch after the rain.
examples.cn: 雨后拖拉机滑进了沟里。

examples.en: They dug a ditch to carry water to the field.
examples.cn: 他们挖了一条沟把水引到田里。

examples.en: She ditched the old phone and bought a simple one.
examples.cn: 她扔掉了旧手机，买了个简单的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 ditch 记成「挖开的一道线」：与 dig 同源，地上挖开一条窄缝就是沟；把东西往沟里一丢，也就是抛弃。

root: 源自古英语 dic（沟、堤），与 dig 同源，本义是挖开地面形成的窄长通道，用来排水或引水。后来从「把东西丢进沟里」引申出抛弃、甩掉的动词用法，现代还指飞机在水面迫降。

sensesIntro.en: From a wet line cut beside a road to a plan dropped without explanation.
sensesIntro.cn: 从路边挖出的一道湿痕，到一个不作解释就被放下的计划。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shallow channel beside a road, filled with rain and a few leaves.
core.cn: 核心意象：路边一道浅沟，积着雨水，漂着几片叶子。

branches.en: The first sense is the open cut in the ground.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是地面上敞开的沟。

branches.en: The second sense throws something into that gap.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把东西丢进这道缝里。

branches.en: Both senses depend on a low place out of sight.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一个看不见的低处。

branches.en: Both take something out of the way.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把某样东西挪到一边。

branches.en: Only the second sense means the thing is unwanted.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项表示那东西不再被需要。

intro.en: Ditch is a plain Old English base, so its family grows by compounds rather than by Latin prefixes.
intro.cn: ditch 是朴素的古英语词根，它的一族靠复合而非拉丁前缀长大。

latinIntro.en: Old English dic, a trench, also gives dike; the same ground word shifts between ditch and bank.
latinIntro.cn: 古英语 dic（沟）也给出 dike，同一个地面词在沟与堤之间摆动。

items.meaning: a channel dug in the ground
items.example: The ditch was full of rain.
The ditches along the road were cleared.
A ditched car sat by the fence.
items.exampleCN: 一辆被丢弃的车停在栅栏边。

items.meaning: the act of getting rid of
a person or machine that digs ditches
the water standing in a ditch
a bank or channel built to hold water
items.example: The dike held back the flood.

definition_en: to jump head first into water, to move down quickly, or to fall sharply in value
core_image: 一个人站在池边，脚尖离水面只有一线，身体向前折下
scene: 池边安静了一秒，他弯下身子。She dived into the cold water without a sound.
sceneCN: 这里 dive 指「跳水」（第 1 个义项：头朝下跃入水中）；句意是她无声地跃入冷水。

senses.title: To go head first into water
senses.definition: to jump into water with your head and arms going first
senses.definitionCN: 头和手臂先入水地跳进水里
senses.example: He dived from the top board.
senses.exampleCN: 他从最高的跳板跳下去。
senses.why: The body makes one clean line before it meets the water.
senses.whyCN: 身体先拉成一条干净的线，才碰到水面。

senses.title: To move down fast
senses.definition: to move quickly downwards or into something
senses.definitionCN: 快速向下移动或扎进某处
senses.example: The plane dived towards the runway.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机朝跑道俯冲。
senses.why: Speed turns a fall into a decision.
senses.whyCN: 有了速度，坠落也像是一个决定。

senses.title: A sharp fall in value
senses.definition: a sudden large drop in prices or numbers
senses.definitionCN: 价格或数字突然大幅下跌
senses.example: Shares took a dive after the news.
senses.exampleCN: 消息出来后股价大跌。
senses.why: A market that climbs slowly can still leave in one jump.
senses.whyCN: 慢慢爬上去的行情，也可能一跳就走。

intro.en: Dive goes back to Old English dyfan, to dip or sink, a word shared with deep.
intro.cn: dive 可追到古英语 dyfan（浸、沉），与 deep 同源。

items.en: Dyfan meant to dip something into liquid.
items.cn: dyfan 指把东西浸进液体。

items.en: A diver was already a man who went under water.
items.cn: 古英语里已有指下水之人的说法。

items.en: The verb settled as dive with a long i sound.
items.cn: 中古英语时动词固定为 dive，元音拉长。

items.en: Sporting dives from boards became a public show.
items.cn: 从跳板跳水成了公开表演。

items.en: The word spread to planes, shares and sudden rushes.
items.cn: 后来扩展到飞机、股价与突然的冲刺。

items.en: Today a team can dive into a project on day one.
items.cn: 今天一支队伍可以第一天就扑进项目。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the dive sound, while the meaning group gathers other downward plunges.
note.cn: 形近组保留 dive 的音形，近义组则是几种向下的猛扎。

entries.definition: a person who works under water
the sport of entering water head first
to make a vehicle move along
to fall or push suddenly downwards
to go completely under water
to fall or let something fall

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a body folded at the pool edge and end with a share price in free fall.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从池边折下的身体开始，落到一路下坠的股价。

normal.en: Dive and deep share an old root: to go down into something.
normal.cn: dive 与 deep 同源，都是往里面下去。

normal.en: She dived under the wave and came up laughing.
normal.cn: 她从浪下钻过去，冒出来时在笑。

normal.en: The goalkeeper dived and just touched the ball.
normal.cn: 守门员扑出去，刚好碰到球。

normal.en: He dived into the report and forgot his lunch.
normal.cn: 他一头扎进报告，连午饭都忘了。

normal.en: Sales dived in the first cold week of winter.
normal.cn: 入冬第一个冷周，销量猛跌。

abstract.en: Picture a body folding into one straight line above water.
abstract.cn: 想象身体在水面上方折成一条直线。

abstract.en: Picture a seabird closing its wings and dropping.
abstract.cn: 想象一只海鸟收翅直落。

abstract.en: Picture a line on a chart falling off the bottom edge.
abstract.cn: 想象图表上的线跌出底边。

examples.en: He dived from the top board without hesitating.
examples.cn: 他从最高跳板毫不犹豫地跳下。

examples.en: Prices dived after the report was published.
examples.cn: 报告公布后价格暴跌。

examples.en: The submarine dived to avoid the storm.
examples.cn: 潜艇下潜以避开风暴。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dive 记成「往深处扎」：与 deep 同源，头朝下钻进水里是跳水，身体往下扑是俯冲，数字往下掉就是暴跌。

root: 源自古英语 dyfan（浸入、下沉），与 deep 同源，本义是往水里或深处钻。由「入水」一义发展出跳水与潜水，又由「向下」引申为俯冲、猛扑与价格急跌，并可用作名词指跳水这一动作。

sensesIntro.en: From a clean line of body above water to a chart line dropping off the page.
sensesIntro.cn: 从水面上方一条干净的身体线，到图表上跌出纸面的一条线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body folded at the pool edge, falling into one straight line.
core.cn: 核心意象：身体在池边折起，落成一条直线。

branches.en: The first sense is entering water head first.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是头朝下入水。

branches.en: The second sense is any fast downward move.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是任何快速向下的移动。

branches.en: The third sense is a number falling like a diver.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是数字像跳水者一样下落。

branches.en: Both senses share one downward line.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享同一条向下的线。

branches.en: Both senses suggest speed that cannot be stopped.
branches.cn: 两个义项都暗示停不下来的速度。

intro.en: Dive belongs to an Old English family of depth words, where deep and dip stand close.
intro.cn: dive 属于古英语的「深」词一族，与 deep 和 dip 站得很近。

latinIntro.en: Old English dyfan, to dip, gives dive; the same depth root also gives deep and dip.
latinIntro.cn: 古英语 dyfan（浸）给出 dive，同一个「深」的词根也给出 deep 与 dip。

items.exampleCN: 一名潜水员检查了船体。

items.meaning: the sport or work of going under
items.example: Diving is taught at the pool.
He dived and surfaced far off.
items.exampleCN: 他跳下去，在远处浮上来。

items.meaning: the American past form of dive
items.example: The bird dove at the water.
She dipped the brush in paint.
The lake is deep at the centre.

definition_en: of many different kinds, or clearly different from one another
core_image: 一张长桌上摆着十几个地方的菜，颜色气味全不一样
scene: 长桌从这头摆到那头，盘子里的颜色没有一样重复。The city has a diverse population.
sceneCN: 这里 diverse 指「多种多样的」（第 1 个义项：种类很多）；句意是这座城市的人口构成十分多样。

senses.title: Made of many kinds
senses.definition: made up of many different kinds of people or things
senses.definitionCN: 由许多不同种类的人或物组成
senses.example: The class is diverse in age and background.
senses.exampleCN: 这个班在年龄与背景上都很杂。
senses.why: A room with many voices is harder to sum up in one word.
senses.whyCN: 满是不同声音的房间，很难用一个词概括。

senses.title: Different from something else
senses.definition: clearly unlike another thing in nature or form
senses.definitionCN: 在性质或形态上与另一物明显不一样
senses.example: Their views are diverse on this point.
senses.exampleCN: 在这一点上他们的看法各不相同。
senses.why: To differ is to turn away on a road you once shared.
senses.whyCN: 所谓不同，就是在同一条路上各自转开。

intro.en: Diverse is Latin diversus, turned aside, from divertere, to turn in different directions.
intro.cn: diverse 是拉丁语 diversus（转开），来自 divertere（转向不同方向）。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn or turn around.
items.cn: vertere 指转动或转身。

items.en: Di- pulled the turning into two directions.
items.cn: 前缀 di- 把转动拉向两个方向。

items.en: Diversus described things turned away from each other.
items.cn: diversus 描述彼此转开的东西。

items.en: English used it for things unlike in kind.
items.cn: 英语借入时说种类不相同的东西。

items.en: The sense of many kinds together grew strong.
items.cn: 后来「多种并存」的意思变强。

items.en: Today a diverse team is valued for its differences.
items.cn: 今天多元的团队正因差异而受重视。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the vertere stem, while the meaning group gathers words for many kinds.
note.cn: 形近组共享 vertere 这段词干，近义组则是几个表示种类多的词。

entries.definition: the state of having many kinds
to add more kinds to something
a turning aside, or a pleasant change
of several different kinds
more than one and not all alike
made of unlike parts put together

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a long table of unlike dishes and end with two views turning apart.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一张摆满不同菜的长桌开始，落到两种各自转开的看法。

normal.en: Di- plus verse: the roads turn in different directions.
normal.cn: di 加 verse，路朝不同方向转开。

normal.en: The market sells diverse goods from a dozen regions.
normal.cn: 这个市场卖着十几个地区的各色货物。

normal.en: A diverse team argues more and misses less.
normal.cn: 多元的团队争得更多，漏掉的更少。

normal.en: Her interests are diverse: birds, boats and old maps.
normal.cn: 她的兴趣很杂：鸟、船和旧地图。

normal.en: The two accounts are diverse in almost every detail.
normal.cn: 这两种说法几乎每个细节都不同。

abstract.en: Picture one road splitting into many smaller roads.
abstract.cn: 想象一条路分成许多小路。

abstract.en: Picture a table where no two bowls hold the same thing.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子，没有两只碗装同样的东西。

abstract.en: Picture two people walking off in opposite directions.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人朝相反方向走开。

examples.en: The city has a diverse population.
examples.cn: 这座城市的人口构成很多元。

examples.en: Her reading is more diverse than mine.
examples.cn: 她读的东西比我的杂得多。

examples.en: The two villages are diverse in language and food.
examples.cn: 这两个村子在语言和饮食上都不一样。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diverse 记成「各自转开」：di 表示分开，verse 表示转，路朝不同方向转开，就有了各种各样的差别。

root: 源自拉丁语 diversus，来自 divertere（转向不同方向），由 di-（分开）与 vertere（转）组成。本义是彼此转开、不朝一处，因此既指种类繁多，也指两物在性质上不同。

sensesIntro.en: From a road splitting into many to two views that no longer face the same way.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条路分成许多条，到两种不再朝同一方向的看法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one long table where no two dishes share a colour.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张长桌，没有两道菜颜色相同。

branches.en: The first sense is many kinds standing together.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是许多种类站在一起。

branches.en: The second sense is one thing turning away from another.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是一物与另一物转开。

branches.en: Both senses begin with a turning apart.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从转开开始。

branches.en: Both make a single label feel too small.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让一个标签显得不够用。

branches.en: Only the first sense needs a crowd of kinds.
branches.cn: 只有第一个义项需要一大群种类。

intro.en: Diverse belongs to the vertere family, where Latin vertere, to turn, gives a crowd of turning words.
intro.cn: diverse 属于 vertere 一族，拉丁语 vertere（转）生出一大串表示转的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere, to turn, gives diverse and divert; di- turns the two paths away from each other.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vertere（转）给出 diverse 与 divert，前缀 di- 把两条路彼此转开。

items.meaning: the state of having many kinds
items.example: The island is known for its diversity.

items.exampleCN: 这组人受过的训练很杂。

items.example: The road diversion added ten minutes.
They converted the barn into a house.
items.exampleCN: 他们把谷仓改成了住宅。

definition_en: the state of including many different kinds of people or things
core_image: 一片林子里高矮粗细不同的树，各自朝着光长
scene: 林子从山脚一直铺到水边，树种多得记不住。The forest is famous for its diversity of birds.
sceneCN: 这里 diversity 指「多样性」（第 1 个义项：种类繁多）；句意是这片森林以鸟类多样而闻名。

senses.title: Many kinds in one place
senses.definition: the state of including many different kinds of people or things
senses.definitionCN: 同一个地方包含许多不同种类的人或物
senses.example: The island is known for its diversity of plants.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛以植物多样著称。
senses.why: A forest is healthiest where no single tree takes the light.
senses.whyCN: 林子里没有一种树独占阳光时，才最健康。

senses.title: A clear difference between things
senses.definition: the quality of being unlike something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物不相同的性质
senses.example: There is real diversity between the two traditions.
senses.exampleCN: 这两种传统之间有真正的差异。
senses.why: Difference becomes a value once people choose to keep it.
senses.whyCN: 差异一旦被人选择保留，就成了价值。

intro.en: Diversity is Latin diversitas, difference, from diversus, turned apart.
intro.cn: diversity 是拉丁语 diversitas（差异），来自 diversus（转开）。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn, as a wheel turns.
items.cn: vertere 指转动，像轮子那样转。

items.en: Diversus described paths turned away from each other.
items.cn: diversus 描述彼此转开的路。

items.en: Diversitas named the state of being unlike.
items.cn: diversitas 指彼此不相同的状态。

items.en: English used it for difference in kind.
items.cn: 英语借入时指种类上的不同。

items.en: The word became a public value in schools and firms.
items.cn: 到了现代，它成了学校与机构公开看重的价值。

items.en: Today it covers species, voices, diets and ideas.
items.cn: 今天它可以指物种、声音、饮食与想法。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the vers stem, while the meaning group names other kinds of variety.
note.cn: 形近组共享 vers 这段词干，近义组则是几种表示繁多的词。

entries.definition: of many different kinds
to make more varied
a turning aside or a pastime
a collection of unlike kinds
the spread of things from one end to another
entries.definitionCN: 事物从一端到另一端的跨度

entries.definition: the way two things are not alike

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a forest of unlike trees and end with two traditions that refuse to merge.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一片高矮不同的林子开始，落到两种不肯合一的传统。

normal.en: Di- plus vers plus -ity: many turnings held in one place.
normal.cn: di 加 vers 再加 ity，许多转向被收在同一处。

normal.en: The report measures diversity in ten city schools.
normal.cn: 这份报告衡量了十所城市学校的多样性。

normal.en: Bees depend on the diversity of flowers in a meadow.
normal.cn: 蜜蜂依赖草地里花种类的多样。

normal.en: A diversity of voices made the meeting longer and better.
normal.cn: 意见多元让会议更长也更好。

normal.en: The island guards its diversity against new species.
normal.cn: 这座岛守护自己的多样，防范外来物种。

abstract.en: Picture trees of every height reaching for the same light.
abstract.cn: 想象高矮不一的树都朝同一片光长。

abstract.en: Picture a market stall with twenty kinds of grain.
abstract.cn: 想象一个摊子上摆着二十种谷物。

abstract.en: Picture two rivers running side by side without joining.
abstract.cn: 想象两条河并流却始终不合。

examples.en: The forest is famous for its diversity of birds.
examples.cn: 这片森林以鸟类多样而闻名。

examples.en: The report calls for diversity in hiring.
examples.cn: 报告呼吁在招聘中重视多元。

examples.en: Diversity of opinion keeps a team honest.
examples.cn: 意见的多样让团队保持诚实。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diversity 记成「转开之后留下的多」：di 表示分开，vers 表示转，许多东西各自转开，同一处就显出丰富的种类与差异。

root: 源自拉丁语 diversitas，来自 diversus（转开），词根 vertere 意为转。本义是彼此转向不同方向的状态，后来指种类繁多，现代又成为一种被公开看重的价值，用于物种、文化、意见等话题。

sensesIntro.en: From a forest where every tree leans its own way to a value that people choose to protect.
sensesIntro.cn: 从每棵树各自斜向一边的林子，到人们选择去保护的某种价值。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stand of trees of every height, each leaning towards the same light.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片高矮不一的树，各自朝同一片光倾斜。

branches.en: The first sense is many kinds sharing one place.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是许多种类共处一地。

branches.en: The second sense is the gap between two of them.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是其中两者之间的差别。

branches.en: Both senses grow from things turned apart.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从转开的事物里长出来。

branches.en: Both are measured by counting what differs.
branches.cn: 两个义项都靠数不同的东西来衡量。

branches.en: Only the second sense can be a single pair.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项可以只是一对事物。

intro.en: Diversity sits in the vertere family, where Latin vertere, to turn, holds a large group of words.
intro.cn: diversity 属于 vertere 一族，拉丁语 vertere（转）撑起一大组词。

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere, to turn, gives diversity and divert; -ity turns the turning into a lasting state.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vertere（转）给出 diversity 与 divert，后缀 -ity 把转动变成一种持续的状态。

items.meaning: the state of holding many kinds
items.exampleCN: 这片礁石显出极大的多样性。
农人靠多样化分散风险。
合唱团的训练背景很杂。

items.example: The loft was converted into a studio.

definition_en: to separate something into parts, to share things out, or to find how many times one number fits another
core_image: 一块面饼被刀从中间按下，两半慢慢分开
scene: 桌上那块饼还热着，刀已经按在正中。Divide the cake into eight equal pieces.
sceneCN: 这里 divide 指「分开」（第 1 个义项：把整体切成几份）；句意是把蛋糕分成八块一样大的。

senses.title: To cut a whole into parts
senses.definition: to separate something into two or more parts
senses.definitionCN: 把一样东西分成两份或更多
senses.example: Divide the dough into two equal balls.
senses.exampleCN: 把面团分成两个一样大的球。
senses.why: A whole resists, then gives along one line.
senses.whyCN: 一个整体先是顶着，随后沿着一条线让开。

senses.title: To share out among people
senses.definition: to give parts of something to different people
senses.definitionCN: 把东西的一部分给不同的人
senses.example: They divided the money among the four of them.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把钱四个人分了。
senses.why: Sharing turns one amount into several claims.
senses.whyCN: 分配把一笔数目变成几份主张。

senses.title: To find how many times one fits another
senses.definition: to calculate how many times one number is contained in another
senses.definitionCN: 算出一个数里含有另一个数多少次
senses.example: Ten divided by two is five.
senses.exampleCN: 十除以二等于五。
senses.why: Division asks how many times one thing fits inside another.
senses.whyCN: 除法问的是一个东西能装进另一个几次。

intro.en: Divide comes from Latin dividere, to force apart, from dis-, apart, and a root meaning to separate.
intro.cn: divide 来自拉丁语 dividere（强行分开），由 dis-（分开）与表示分离的词根构成。

items.en: Dividere meant to part or force things asunder.
items.cn: dividere 指分开或把东西强行拆开。

items.en: A divider marked where the land was cut.
items.cn: divider 指标出土地被切之处的界物。

items.en: Dividere also covered sharing among heirs.
items.cn: dividere 也指在继承人之间分配。

items.en: English used it for cutting and for sharing.
items.cn: 英语借入后既指切开，也指分享。

items.en: Arithmetic gave it the sense of finding a quotient.
items.cn: 算术给了它求商的意思。

items.en: Today a road, a bill and a nation can all divide.
items.cn: 今天道路、账单与国家都可以被分开。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the dividere stem, while the meaning group gathers other verbs of parting and sharing.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dividere 这段词干，近义组则是几个表示分开与分享的动词。

entries.definition: the act of separating, or a department
able to be divided exactly
one single person
to put or keep apart
to break along a line
to give a part to others

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a knife pressed into warm bread and end with a sum written on paper.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从刀压进热面包开始，落到纸上写下的一道算式。

normal.en: Di- plus vide: a line is forced through the whole.
normal.cn: di 加 vide，一条线被强行穿过整体。

normal.en: Divide the class into four groups before the game.
normal.cn: 比赛前把全班分成四组。

normal.en: They divided the work so nobody waited.
normal.cn: 他们分了工，谁也不闲着。

normal.en: Twelve divided by four leaves three.
normal.cn: 十二除以四得三。

normal.en: The question divided the room into two camps.
normal.cn: 这个问题把屋里的人分成两派。

abstract.en: Picture a knife pressed down the middle of a loaf.
abstract.cn: 想象一把刀从面包正中压下去。

abstract.en: Picture a fence line drawn across a shared field.
abstract.cn: 想象一块共有的田被一道篱笆分开。

abstract.en: Picture a number broken into equal little piles.
abstract.cn: 想象一个数被分成几小堆。

examples.en: Divide the class into two groups.
examples.cn: 把全班分成两组。

examples.en: They divided the money equally.
examples.cn: 他们把钱平均分了。

examples.en: Nine divided by three is three.
examples.cn: 九除以三等于三。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 divide 记成「一刀分开」：di 表示分开，vide 与「分」有关，一刀下去整体成几份，分开之后还能分给人，也能用来做除法。

root: 源自拉丁语 dividere（强行分开），由 dis-（分开）与表示分离的词根组成。本义是把整体切开，后来扩展到把东西分给众人，又进入算术表示除法，也用于道路、账单、意见等被分成几部分。

sensesIntro.en: From a knife pressed into a warm loaf to a sum that splits one number into equal piles.
sensesIntro.cn: 从刀压进温热的面包，到把数目分成相等几堆的一道算式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a knife pressed into the middle of a warm loaf, the two halves easing apart.
core.cn: 核心意象：刀压在热面包正中，两半慢慢让开。

branches.en: The first sense is the physical cut.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是实在地切开。

branches.en: The second sense is the cut turned into shares.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把切开变成各得一份。

branches.en: The third sense counts how many parts fit.
branches.cn: 第三个义项数的是一个里面能装几个。

branches.en: Both senses begin with one thing becoming several.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从一开始，变成好几个。

branches.en: Both senses depend on an exact line or number.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖准确的界线或数目。

intro.en: Divide belongs to the dividere family, where the stem gives words for parts, numbers and single persons.
intro.cn: divide 属于 dividere 一族，这个词干生出表示部分、数目与个人的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin dividere, to force apart, gives divide and division; -ible and -or turn it towards arithmetic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dividere（分开）给出 divide 与 division，后缀 -ible 与 -or 把它推向算术。

items.meaning: to force a whole into parts
the act of dividing, or a part
a thing that keeps parts apart
items.example: A low divider split the room.
items.exampleCN: 一道矮隔断把房间分开。

items.example: She gave the work her undivided attention.
items.exampleCN: 她把全部注意力放在这件事上。

items.meaning: one that cannot be cut further

definition_en: the act of separating something into parts, a part of a large organization, or the sharing out of something
core_image: 一条走廊把办公楼分成两半，门牌各自挂在两边
scene: 走廊从电梯口一直通到底，左右两边各挂一块门牌。She works in the sales division.
sceneCN: 这里 division 指「部门」（第 2 个义项：机构里分出的单位）；句意是她在销售部门工作。

collocations.phrase: the division between rich and poor

senses.title: The act of splitting, or the split itself
senses.definition: the act of separating into parts, or the state of being split into opposing sides
senses.definitionCN: 把整体分开的行为，或分成对立两边的状态
senses.example: The division of the land took years.
senses.exampleCN: 这块地的划分花了好几年。
senses.why: A line drawn once can keep two sides facing each other for a long time.
senses.whyCN: 画下的一条线，能让两边对望很久。

senses.title: A part of an organization
senses.definition: a large unit inside a company or an official body
senses.definitionCN: 公司或机构内部的一个大单位
senses.example: She works in the sales division.
senses.exampleCN: 她在销售部工作。
senses.why: A big body divides its work so each part can be watched.
senses.whyCN: 大机构把工作分开，每一块才看得住。

senses.title: The arithmetic of sharing into equal parts
senses.definition: the process of finding how many times one number fits into another
senses.definitionCN: 求一个数里含有另一个数多少次的运算
senses.example: Long division still troubles some students.
senses.exampleCN: 长除法至今让一些学生头疼。
senses.why: Numbers are split as neatly as bread, but with no crumbs.
senses.whyCN: 数字也能像面包一样分开，只是不掉渣。

intro.en: Division is Latin divisio, a parting, from dividere, to force apart.
intro.cn: division 是拉丁语 divisio（分开），来自 dividere（强行拆开）。

items.en: Dividere meant to part what was joined.
items.cn: dividere 指把连在一起的东西分开。

items.en: Divisio named the act and the line it left.
items.cn: divisio 指分开的动作与留下的界线。

items.en: A divisio also meant a share given to an heir.
items.cn: divisio 也指分给继承人的一份。

items.en: English used it for splitting and for shares.
items.cn: 英语借入后指切开与分得的一份。

items.en: Army and trade gave it the sense of a unit.
items.cn: 军队与商业给了它「单位」的意思。

items.en: Today a division can be a sum, a team or a quarrel.
items.cn: 今天一个 division 可以是一道除法、一个团队或一场争执。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the dividere stem, while the meaning group names other kinds of parting.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dividere 这段词干，近义组则是几种分开的名目。

entries.definition: to split or share out
able to be divided exactly
a part of a part
the state of being apart
one part of a whole
a break along a line

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a corridor halving a building and end with a sum done on paper.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一条把楼分成两半的走廊开始，落到纸上做完的一道算式。

normal.en: Divide plus -ion: the cut has become a lasting line.
normal.cn: divide 加 ion，切开成了留下来的界线。

normal.en: The division between the two teams is only on paper.
normal.cn: 两个组之间的划分只写在纸上。

normal.en: He was moved to the research division last spring.
normal.cn: 去年春天他被调到研究部。

normal.en: Division is the one sum that asks how many fit inside.
normal.cn: 除法是唯一问「里面能装几个」的运算。

normal.en: A division of opinion delayed the vote.
normal.cn: 意见分歧让表决推迟了。

abstract.en: Picture two queues forming at one wide door.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇宽门前排成两队。

examples.cn: 这块地的划分花了三年。

examples.en: He moved to the research division.
examples.cn: 他调到了研究部。

examples.en: Division is easier with a calculator.
examples.cn: 有了计算器，除法容易多了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 division 记成「切开留下的线」：divide 是切，加上名词尾，就成了划分、分出的部门，也算术里的除法。

root: 源自拉丁语 divisio，来自 dividere（强行拆开）。本义是切开以及切开后留下的界线，也指分给继承人的一份。后来在军队与商业中指机构中的一个单位，在算术中指除法。

sensesIntro.en: From a corridor splitting a building to a sum that asks how many fit inside.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条把楼分开的走廊，到一道问「里面能装几个」的算式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long corridor halving a building, a name plate on each side.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条长走廊把楼分成两半，两边各挂一块门牌。

branches.en: The first sense is the cut and the line it leaves.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是切开以及留下的界线。

branches.en: The second sense is an official share of a large body.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是大机构里正式分出的一块。

branches.en: The third sense splits numbers instead of rooms.
branches.cn: 第三个义项分的是数字，不是房间。

branches.en: Both senses turn one large thing into named parts.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把一个大东西变成有名字的几块。

branches.en: Both senses depend on an exact rule of splitting.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖准确的切分规则。

intro.en: Division belongs to the dividere family, where one stem serves rooms, offices and arithmetic.
intro.cn: division 属于 dividere 一族，同一个词干同时服务房间、办公室与算术。

latinIntro.en: Latin dividere, to force apart, gives division and divide; -ive and -ible pull it towards conflict and numbers.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dividere（分开）给出 division 与 divide，后缀 -ive 与 -ible 把它拉向冲突与数字。

items.meaning: the act of parting, or a parted unit

definition_en: the legal ending of a marriage, or a complete separation between two things
core_image: 两只箱子原先把把手系在一起，绳结被剪断，各自拖开
scene: 门口两只旧箱子本来用绳系着，绳子已经剪断。They agreed to a divorce after twenty years.
sceneCN: 这里 divorce 指「离婚」（第 1 个义项：依法结束婚姻）；句意是二十年后他们同意离婚。

senses.title: The legal end of a marriage
senses.definition: the official and legal ending of a marriage
senses.definitionCN: 婚姻在法律上正式结束
senses.example: The divorce was final in June.
senses.exampleCN: 离婚在六月正式生效。
senses.why: A shared life is untied by a document and a signature.
senses.whyCN: 共同的生活，被一纸文书和一枚签名解开。

senses.title: To end a marriage legally
senses.definition: to end your marriage with someone by law
senses.definitionCN: 依法结束与某人的婚姻
senses.example: She divorced him last year.
senses.exampleCN: 她去年和他离了婚。
senses.why: One person can begin the ending, even when both must sign.
senses.whyCN: 结束可以由一个人提出，却要两个人都签字。

senses.title: To cut two things apart
senses.definition: to separate two things that were closely joined
senses.definitionCN: 把原本紧密相连的两样东西分开
senses.example: You cannot divorce art from its time.
senses.exampleCN: 不能把艺术和它的时代分开。
senses.why: Some pairs only look joined, and part without a sound.
senses.whyCN: 有些搭配只是看着相连，分开时毫无声响。

intro.en: Divorce comes from Latin divortium, a turning apart, from divertere, to turn in different ways.
intro.cn: divorce 来自拉丁语 divortium（转开），源头是 divertere（转向不同方向）。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn, as a body turns away.
items.cn: vertere 指转动，像人转身那样。

items.en: Di- sent the two turning paths apart.
items.cn: 前缀 di- 把两条转向的路分开。

items.en: Divortium named the formal parting of a marriage.
items.cn: divortium 指婚姻的正式分离。

items.en: Old French divorce kept the legal sense.
items.cn: 古法语 divorce 保留了法律意味。

items.en: English used it for the ending of a marriage.
items.cn: 英语借入时指婚姻的结束。

items.en: Today ideas and habits can be divorced as well.
items.cn: 今天想法与习惯也可以用这个词分开。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the vertere turning, while the meaning group names other kinds of parting.
note.cn: 形近组保留 vertere 的「转」，近义组则是几种分开的名目。

entries.definition: to turn something aside
of many different kinds
a person whose marriage has ended
the state of living or being apart
entries.definitionCN: 生活上或位置上的分开

entries.definition: a break between two joined things
the end of a relationship

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two cases tied by one rope and end with art cut off from its age.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从两只被一根绳系住的箱子开始，落到被割离时代的艺术。

normal.en: Di- plus vorce: the shared road turns into two roads.
normal.cn: di 加 vorce，共同的路转成两条。

normal.cn: 他们的离婚安静而办得很快。

normal.cn: 她和他离了婚，搬去了海边。

normal.en: You cannot divorce a song from the room it was sung in.
normal.cn: 不能把一首歌和它被唱的那个房间分开。

normal.en: A divorce from daily facts weakens any argument.
normal.cn: 脱离日常事实，任何论证都会变弱。

abstract.en: Picture two cases tied by a rope that is then cut.
abstract.cn: 想象两只箱子被一根绳系着，绳子随后被剪断。

abstract.en: Picture a page torn cleanly along a fold.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸沿着折痕整齐撕开。

abstract.en: Picture two names erased from one shared line.
abstract.cn: 想象两个名字从同一行里被擦掉。

examples.en: The divorce was final in June.
examples.cn: 离婚在六月正式生效。

examples.en: She divorced him after ten years.
examples.cn: 十年之后她和他离了婚。

examples.en: You cannot divorce art from its time.
examples.cn: 不能把艺术和它的时代分开。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 divorce 记成「转开各自走」：di 表示分开，vorce 与转同源，原本并肩的两条路一转开，婚姻或关系也就断了。

root: 源自拉丁语 divortium，来自 divertere（转向不同方向），由 di-（分开）与 vertere（转）组成。本义是两人转身各走一边，专指婚姻在法律上结束，后来也用于把紧密相连的事物强行分开。

sensesIntro.en: From two cases cut loose from one rope to a piece of art torn from its own age.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两只被剪断绳子的箱子，到一件被割离自身时代的艺术品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two old cases tied by one rope, the knot cut, each dragged its own way.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只旧箱子被一根绳系着，绳结剪断，各自拖开。

branches.en: The first sense is the legal end as a fact.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是作为事实的法律结束。

branches.en: The second sense is the act of ending it.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是结束婚姻的那个动作。

branches.en: The third sense cuts apart things that are not marriages.
branches.cn: 第三个义项分开的不是婚姻。

branches.en: Both senses concern one marriage and two signatures.
branches.cn: 两个义项都关乎一桩婚姻与两个签名。

branches.en: Both senses describe a lasting separation.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述一种持久的分开。

intro.en: Divorce belongs to the vertere family, where Latin vertere, to turn, also gives divert and diverse.
intro.cn: divorce 属于 vertere 一族，拉丁语 vertere（转）也给出 divert 与 diverse。

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere, to turn, gives divorce and divert; di- turns one shared path into two.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vertere（转）给出 divorce 与 divert，前缀 di- 把一条共同的路变成两条。

definition_en: a person trained to treat sick people, a person with the highest university degree, or to change something dishonestly

scene: 排号的人抬头看屏幕，白大褂从走廊那头快步过来。The doctor asked him to breathe slowly.
sceneCN: 这里 doctor 指「医生」（第 1 个义项：给人看病的人）；句意是医生让他慢慢呼吸。

senses.title: One who treats the sick
senses.definition: a person trained and licensed to treat illness
senses.definitionCN: 受过训练并有资格给人看病的人
senses.example: The doctor listened to his chest.
senses.exampleCN: 医生听了听他的胸口。
senses.why: A stranger is allowed to ask the most personal questions.
senses.whyCN: 一个陌生人却被允许问最私密的问题。

senses.title: The highest university degree, or its holder
senses.definition: a person who holds the highest degree a university gives
senses.definitionCN: 拥有大学所授最高学位的人
senses.example: She became a doctor of history at thirty.
senses.exampleCN: 她三十岁时成了历史学博士。
senses.why: The title once meant teacher, and it still does.
senses.whyCN: 这个头衔原意是教师，今天仍然如此。

senses.title: To change something dishonestly
senses.definition: to add something to food or drink, or to change records to deceive
senses.definitionCN: 往饮食里掺东西，或改动记录以骗人
senses.example: Someone had doctored the accounts.
senses.exampleCN: 有人篡改过账目。
senses.why: A small false mark can make a whole page lie.
senses.whyCN: 一个假的小记号，就能让整页纸说谎。

intro.en: Doctor is Latin for teacher, from docere, to teach; the medical sense came later.
intro.cn: doctor 在拉丁语里就是「教师」，来自 docere（教），医学义是后来才有的。

items.en: Docere meant to teach or to show clearly.
items.cn: docere 指教导或清楚地展示。

items.en: Doctor named a teacher of the church.
items.cn: doctor 指教会的教师。

items.en: English used it for a learned teacher.
items.cn: 英语借入时指有学问的教师。

items.en: The word settled on those licensed to heal.
items.cn: 后来这个词落在获准行医的人身上。

items.en: The verb appeared with the sense of tampering.
items.cn: 动词形式出现了「动手脚」的意思。

items.en: Today a doctor can heal a patient or fake a report.
items.cn: 今天医生能治病，也能伪造报告。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the docere stem, while the meaning group gathers words for those who heal.
note.cn: 形近组共享 docere 这段词干，近义组则是几个指医者的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a row of chairs at a clinic door and end with a page quietly faked.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从诊室门口一排椅子开始，落到一页被悄悄改过的纸。

normal.en: Doctor and docere: the title first meant teacher.
normal.cn: doctor 与 docere 同源，这个头衔原意是教师。

normal.en: The doctor wrote a short note and sent him home.
normal.cn: 医生写了一张短条，让他回家。

normal.cn: 她是法学博士，不是医生。

normal.en: Someone had doctored the date on the letter.
normal.cn: 有人改过信上的日期。

normal.en: The juice was doctored with sugar and colour.
normal.cn: 这果汁掺了糖和色素。

abstract.en: Picture a white coat moving fast down a corridor.
abstract.cn: 想象一件白大褂在走廊里快步走过。

abstract.en: Picture a rolled degree tied with a thin ribbon.
abstract.cn: 想象一卷学位证书，用细带系着。

abstract.en: Picture a number quietly changed by one digit.
abstract.cn: 想象一个数字被悄悄改了一位。

examples.en: The doctor asked him to breathe slowly.
examples.cn: 医生让他慢慢呼吸。

examples.en: She is a doctor of history at a small college.
examples.cn: 她在一所小学院任历史学博士。

examples.en: The report had been doctored before it was sent.
examples.cn: 这份报告寄出之前被人改过。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 doctor 记成「教你的人」：doc 表示教，最初指有学问的教师，后来指能教人怎么治病的人，也就是医生；把记录偷偷改过，也叫 doctor。

root: 源自拉丁语 doctor（教师），来自 docere（教、使明白）。最初指有学问的教师，中古英语借入后用于饱学之士，十六世纪起固定在获准行医的人身上，因此既是医生也是博士。动词「篡改、掺假」由「动手加工」一义发展而来。

sensesIntro.en: From a teacher of learned books to the white coat at the clinic door, and then to a faked page.
sensesIntro.cn: 从教人读书的教师，到诊室门口的白大褂，再到一页被造假的纸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of chairs at a clinic door and a white coat coming fast along the corridor.
core.cn: 核心意象：诊室门口一排椅子，白大褂沿走廊快步过来。

branches.en: The first sense is the healer people wait for.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是众人等候的治病者。

branches.en: The second sense is the highest degree and its holder.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是最高学位及其持有者。

branches.en: The third sense turns skill into dishonest handling.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把本事变成骗人的动手脚。

branches.en: Both senses carry the old idea of a learned person.
branches.cn: 两个义项都带着「有学问的人」这层旧意。

branches.en: Both senses depend on knowledge others do not have.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖别人没有的知识。

intro.en: Doctor belongs to the docere family, where Latin docere, to teach, gives a cluster of learning words.
intro.cn: doctor 属于 docere 一族，拉丁语 docere（教）生出一组与学问有关的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin docere, to teach, gives doctor and doctrine; -al and -ate mark the degree and its holder.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 docere（教）给出 doctor 与 doctrine，后缀 -al 与 -ate 标出学位与持有者。
